EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI VLA

sim-ready 3D asset generation task-driven worlds sim-to-real transfer embodied policy training cross-simulator deployment

简要说明：EmbodiedGen V2是一个生成式3D世界引擎，可自动从资产组装成可仿真环境，支持操作、导航和移动操作，并成功实现了从仿真到真实策略的迁移。

TLDR: EmbodiedGen V2 is a generative 3D world engine that automatically assembles simulation-ready environments from assets, supporting manipulation, navigation, and mobile manipulation, with demonstrated success in bridging sim-to-real policy transfer.

Abstract: We present EmbodiedGen V2, a generative 3D world engine for building executable sim-ready environments for embodied intelligence. Sim-ready 3D asset generation has advanced rapidly, yet assembling such assets into policy-ready task environments remains largely manual, limiting scalable closed-loop learning. EmbodiedGen V2 addresses this gap through a unified sim-ready representation that connects cross-simulator assets, interaction affordances, task-driven worlds, large-scale multi-room scenes, and stateful Vibe Coding into a generative, editable, and reusable simulation pipeline. The generated environments support manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, cross-simulator deployment, and embodied policy training. In evaluation, the asset pipeline achieves 96.5% human acceptance and 98.6% collision success, and 83.3% of task-driven worlds are directly usable for downstream simulation without manual modification. Online reinforcement learning with generated environments further improves simulation success from 9.7% to 79.8%, and transfers to real robots with task success increasing from 21.7% to 75.0%. These results establish EmbodiedGen V2 as scalable simulation infrastructure for training, evaluating, and deploying embodied policies.

摘要（中文）：我们推出EmbodiedGen V2，这是一个生成式3D世界引擎，用于为具身智能构建可直接执行的仿真就绪环境。尽管仿真就绪的3D资产生成技术已取得快速进展，但将这些资产组装成策略就绪的任务环境仍主要依赖人工操作，限制了可扩展的闭环学习。EmbodiedGen V2通过一种统一的仿真就绪表征来弥补这一差距，该表征将跨仿真器的资产、交互可供性、任务驱动世界、大规模多房间场景以及有状态的Vibe Coding连接成一个可生成、可编辑且可复用的仿真流水线。生成的环境支持操作、导航、移动操作、跨仿真器部署以及具身策略训练。在评估中，资产流水线实现了96.5%的人类接受率和98.6%的碰撞成功率，83.3%的任务驱动世界无需人工修改即可直接用于下游仿真。基于生成环境的在线强化学习将仿真成功率从9.7%提升至79.8%，并迁移至真实机器人，任务成功率从21.7%提升至75.0%。这些结果确立了EmbodiedGen V2作为用于训练、评估和部署具身策略的可扩展仿真基础设施。

Authors: Xinjie Wang, Liu Liu, Taojun Ding, Andrew Choi, Chaodong Huang, Mengao Zhao, Ziang Li, Jackson Jiang, Chunlei Yu, Shengxiang Liu, Wei Xu, Zhizhong Su

WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time VLA

test-time training world-action models human video steering self-supervised video prediction key-value memory

简要说明：WAM-TTT 提出了一种测试时训练框架，通过自监督视频预测将未标注的人类视频存储为轻量级记忆，从而无需机器人演示或微调即可引导世界-动作模型适应新任务。

TLDR: WAM-TTT introduces a test-time training framework that adapts world-action models to new tasks using unlabeled human videos, storing them as lightweight memory via self-supervised video prediction, enabling steering without robot demonstrations or fine-tuning.

Abstract: Steering robot foundation models (RFMs) toward new task variants or user-preferred behaviors remains challenging, often requiring additional robot demonstrations, task-specific fine-tuning, or long-context conditioning. We present WAM-TTT, a test-time training framework for steering world action models from raw human videos. Rather than treating human videos as trajectories to imitate, WAM-TTT absorbs them into a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen WAM through self-supervised video prediction. To make this memory useful for control, we introduce a meta-training stage that aligns human demonstrations with robot behaviors using paired human-robot data and a key--value memory reconstruction objective. At test time, only unlabeled human videos are required to adapt the memory, while the pretrained WAM remains frozen. This enables efficient and reusable steering without robot actions, human-side annotations, or task-specific fine-tuning, while preserving the generalization ability of the foundation model. Extensive experiments show that WAM-TTT consistently outperforms in-context human-video conditioning baselines across diverse manipulation tasks and generalization settings.

摘要（中文）：将机器人基础模型（RFMs）引导至新的任务变体或用户偏好行为仍具挑战性，通常需要额外采集机器人示教数据、进行任务特定微调或引入长上下文条件。我们提出WAM-TTT，一种从原始人类视频引导世界动作模型的测试时训练框架。WAM-TTT并非将人类视频视为可模仿的轨迹，而是通过自监督视频预测将其吸收至冻结的WAM内部的轻量级自适应记忆模块中。为使该记忆有效服务于控制任务，我们引入元训练阶段，利用配对的人-机器人数据及键值记忆重建目标，将人类示教与机器人行为对齐。在测试阶段，仅需未标注的人类视频即可适配记忆模块，而预训练的WAM保持冻结状态。该方法无需机器人动作、人工标注或任务特定微调即可实现高效且可复用的引导，同时保留基础模型的泛化能力。大量实验表明，WAM-TTT在多样化操作任务与泛化场景中，始终优于基于上下文人类视频条件的基线方法。

Authors: Yusen Feng, Bingchen Han, Jiangran Lyu, Kai Liu, Yixin Zheng, Yuxuan Wan, Weiheng Liu, Sun Han, Ruiqin Li, Yulong Zhang, Fangfu Liu, Xuesong Shi, Libin Liu, Yizhou Wang, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang

Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation VLA

latent memory vision-language-action robotic manipulation long-horizon memory-augmented VLA

简要说明：LaMem-VLA 通过将短期和长期历史经验以潜在记忆令牌的形式直接融入 VLA 推理，提升了机器人在长时域操作任务上的表现。

TLDR: LaMem-VLA introduces a dual latent memory system that interleaves short-term and long-term historical experience directly into VLA reasoning via latent tokens, improving long-horizon robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Mainstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predict actions primarily from the current observation under a Markovian assumption, thus struggling with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Existing memory-augmented VLAs either expand the observation window or retrieve history from the memory bank as auxiliary policy-side context. However, they leave memory outside the native latent embedding space of VLA reasoning, preventing historical experience from being fluidly interleaved with multimodal reasoning and action formation. To this end, we introduce LaMem-VLA, a latent-memory-native framework that reconstructs historical experience into latent memory tokens and directly interweaves them with VLA reasoning. At its core, LaMem-VLA introduces four coordinated components: (i) a curator that organizes historical experience into two complementary short-term and long-term memory vaults; (ii) a seeker that queries both vaults using the multimodal cognition to retrieve context-relevant evidence; (iii) a condenser that reconstructs the retrieved evidence into compact short-term and long-term latent memory tokens; and (iv) a weaver that injects these memory tokens with the current observation and instruction into one continuous embedding sequence. By representing, retrieving, and consuming historical experience entirely in the same continuous latent space, LaMem-VLA enables memory to directly participate in VLA reasoning and guide action generation under a bounded context. Extensive experiments on SimplerEnv and LIBERO demonstrate the superiority of our LaMem-VLA.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 主流视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在马尔可夫假设下主要依据当前观测预测动作，因此难以处理长期、时间依赖的任务。现有的记忆增强型VLA方法要么扩展观测窗口，要么从记忆库中检索历史信息作为辅助策略侧上下文。然而，这些方法将记忆置于VLA推理的本征潜在嵌入空间之外，阻碍历史经验与多模态推理及动作形成的流畅交织。为此，我们提出LaMem-VLA——一种原生潜在记忆框架，将历史经验重构为潜在记忆标记，并直接将其与VLA推理交织融合。其核心由四个协同组件构成：（i）管理者模块，将历史经验组织为互补的短期与长期记忆库；（ii）搜寻者模块，基于多模态认知对两个记忆库进行查询以检索上下文相关证据；（iii）压缩者模块，将检索到的证据重构为紧凑的短期与长期潜在记忆标记；（iv）编织者模块，将这些记忆标记与当前观测及指令注入同一连续嵌入序列。通过在同一连续潜在空间中实现对历史经验的表征、检索与消耗，LaMem-VLA使记忆能够直接参与VLA推理，并在有限上下文条件下引导动作生成。在SimplerEnv与LIBERO上的大量实验证明了LaMem-VLA的优越性。

Authors: Hongyu Qu, Jianzhe Gao, Xiaobin Hu, Shaohuan Yang, Xinlei Yu, Rui Yan, Wenguan Wang, Xiangbo Shu, Shuicheng Yan

CARLA-GS: Decoupling Representation, Reasoning, and Physics Simulation for Autonomous Driving Corner-Case Synthesis AutonomousDriving

corner-case synthesis Gaussian splitting multi-agent LLM physics-based control CARLA simulator

简要说明：CARLA-GS 是一个用于自动驾驶极端案例合成的模块化流水线，它将视觉表示（可编辑的高斯泼溅）、语义推理（多智能体大语言模型）和物理执行（CARLA PID 控制）解耦，生成逼真且物理可行的自我中心视频。

TLDR: CARLA-GS is a modular pipeline for autonomous driving corner-case synthesis that decouples visual representation (editable Gaussian splatting), semantic reasoning (multi-agent LLM), and physics-based execution (CARLA PID control), producing photorealistic and physically feasible ego-centric videos.

Abstract: Safety evaluation for autonomous driving is dominated by rare, safety-critical interactions, motivating simulators that can deliberately synthesize corner cases with photorealistic observations. Corner-case generation is inherently a multi-source problem spanning visual representation, scene reasoning, and vehicle trajectory generation and control. Prior knowledge- and model-based approaches typically focus on scene or trajectory components in isolation, while diffusion-based methods attempt end-to-end generation but still struggle to ensure spatiotemporal consistency and physical realism. To unify these aspects within a single framework, we propose CARLA-GS, a modular corner-case synthesis pipeline that decouples visual representation, semantic reasoning, and physics-based execution while maintaining tight cross-module coupling. Starting from real driving data, we reconstruct an editable gaussian scene with additional geometry-consistent constraints. A multi-agent LLM then performs scene-level reasoning to identify risky interactions and generate intent-level waypoint trajectories, while the low-level motion control is delegated to CARLA, where a PID controller ensures kinematic and dynamic feasibility. The simulated vehicle states are finally re-projected into the gaussian scene for ego-centric rendering. This design enables high-level semantic reasoning, low-level physically executable motion, and photorealistic corner-case generation within a unified pipeline. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show, both quantitatively and qualitatively, that our framework enables controllable corner-case generation and produces photorealistic, spatiotemporally consistent videos aligned with semantic intent and physically feasible motion.

摘要（中文）：自主驾驶的安全性评估主要依赖于罕见且安全攸关的交互场景，这推动了能够有意识地合成具有逼真观测的极端案例的模拟器的发展。极端案例的生成本质上是一个涉及视觉表征、场景推理、车辆轨迹生成与控制的多源问题。先验知识与模型驱动的方法通常孤立地处理场景或轨迹组件，而基于扩散的方法试图实现端到端生成，但仍难以保证时空一致性与物理真实感。为将这些方面统一至单一框架，我们提出了CARLA-GS——一种模块化极端案例合成流水线，它在解耦视觉表征、语义推理与基于物理的执行的同时，保持模块间的紧密耦合。从真实驾驶数据出发，我们通过附加几何一致性约束重建可编辑的高斯场景。随后，多智能体大语言模型执行场景级推理以识别风险交互并生成意图级路点轨迹，而底层运动控制则交由CARLA处理，其中PID控制器确保运动学与动力学可行性。最终，模拟的车辆状态被重新投影至高斯场景以生成自我中心视角渲染。这一设计使得高层次语义推理、低层次物理可执行运动以及照片级真实感的极端案例生成能够在统一流水线中实现。在Waymo开放数据集上的实验表明，定性与定量结果均证明，我们的框架能够实现可控的极端案例生成，并产生既符合语义意图又具备物理可行运动的高逼真度、时空一致视频。

Authors: Kaicong Huang, Meng Ma, Ruimin Ke

EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data Manipulation

World Action Models human-to-robot transfer egocentric human data 3D motion flow bimanual manipulation

简要说明：EgoWAM 研究了世界动作模型（WAM）在人类到机器人迁移中的应用，表明使用 3D 运动流或 DINO 特征而非像素作为世界预测目标，在利用野外自我中心人类数据共同训练时，能显著提高策略的泛化能力和真实世界双臂任务的表现。

TLDR: EgoWAM investigates world action models (WAMs) for human-to-robot transfer, showing that predicting 3D motion flow or DINO features as world targets, rather than pixels, significantly improves policy generalization and performance in real-world bimanual tasks when co-training with in-the-wild egocentric human data.

Abstract: Egocentric human data offers scalable supervision for robot manipulation. However, behavior cloning entangles transferable content like objects, scenes, and task semantics, with non-transferable factors like human morphology, head motion, and behavioral style. We study whether World Action Models (WAMs) provide a better training signal by requiring policies to predict not only actions, but also how the scene evolves. The central question is what world representation best enables human-to-robot transfer. We hypothesize that an effective world target should abstract appearance, capture agent-invariant physical effects, and separate camera motion from environment change. We introduce EgoWAM, a controlled human-robot co-training framework that fixes the policy backbone, action head, and data mixture while varying only the world prediction target, comparing Pixel, DINO, and 3D motion flow. Across three real-world bimanual tasks, WAM co-training scales more effectively with in-the-wild egocentric human data than behavior cloning. Pixel-based prediction transfers weakly, while DINO and 3D flow yield substantial gains: DINO improves out-of-distribution object and scene generalization by up to 4x, and 3D flow improves in-domain performance by 20-30%. More details: https://gatech-rl2.github.io/egowam.github.io

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的人类数据为机器人操作提供了可扩展的监督信号。然而，行为克隆将物体、场景和任务语义等可迁移内容，与人类形态、头部运动和行为风格等不可迁移因素纠缠在一起。我们研究世界动作模型（WAMs）是否通过要求策略不仅预测动作，还预测场景如何演变，从而提供更好的训练信号。核心问题在于何种世界表征最能实现从人类到机器人的迁移。我们假设，一个有效的世界目标应当抽象外观、捕捉与智能体无关的物理效应，并将相机运动与环境变化分离。我们提出了EgoWAM——一个受控的人机协同训练框架，该框架固定策略主干、动作头和数据混合方式，仅改变世界预测目标，并在Pixel、DINO和3D运动流之间进行比较。在三个真实世界的双臂任务中，与行为克隆相比，WAM协同训练能够更有效地利用野外自我中心人类数据进行扩展。基于像素的预测迁移效果较弱，而DINO和3D流则带来了显著提升：DINO将分布外物体和场景的泛化能力提升至多4倍，3D流将领域内性能提升20-30%。更多详情：https://gatech-rl2.github.io/egowam.github.io

Authors: Baoyu Li, Xinchen Yin, Mengying Lin, Yixin Zhang, Danfei Xu

Context-Aware Force Estimation for Deformable Tool Manipulation in Robotic Environmental Swabbing via Few-Shot Continual Adaptation Manipulation

deformable tool manipulation contact force estimation few-shot adaptation FiLM conditioning LSTM

简要说明：本文提出了一个基于少样本持续自适应的方法，仅利用本体感知来估计变形工具在操作过程中与环境的接触力，并在UR5e机器人上针对多种表面和柔顺条件进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a few-shot continual adaptation framework for estimating tip contact force during deformable tool manipulation using only proprioceptive sensing, validated on a UR5e robot across diverse surface and compliance conditions.

Abstract: Robotic surface swabbing requires sustained interaction between a compliant tool and heterogeneous environments, where accurate estimation of tip-level contact force is critical for consistent sampling performance. However, deformable tool dynamics introduce nonlinear viscoelastic hysteresis that decouples wrist-mounted force measurements from true contact forces, while tool-integrated sensors are impractical for deployment due to sterility and disposability constraints. This paper presents a data-driven framework for contact force estimation in Deformable Tool Manipulation (DTM) that leverages proprioceptive sensing without requiring explicit physical models or permanent embedded sensing hardware at the tool tip. A recurrent architecture is first identified through a comparative evaluation of temporal models, where a compact LSTM achieves the lowest estimation error and sub-millisecond inference latency. To address generalization across unseen surfaces and tool compliance conditions, we introduce a parameter-isolated few-shot adaptation strategy that augments a frozen recurrent backbone with low-dimensional context embeddings using feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). Experiments on a UR5e platform across nine tool-surface interaction regimes demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves robustness under domain shift, reducing zero-shot estimation error by up to 63\% while preserving baseline performance without catastrophic forgetting. These results show that separating shared deformation-history dynamics from domain-specific conditioning enables reliable force estimation for DTM in non-stationary environments.

摘要（中文）：机器人表面擦拭需要柔性工具与异质环境之间保持持续接触，其中尖端接触力的精确估计对于获得一致的采样性能至关重要。然而，可变形工具动力学引入的非线性粘弹性迟滞效应会导致腕部安装的力传感器测量值与真实接触力产生偏差，而工具集成式传感器因受限于灭菌要求及一次性使用约束而难以实际部署。本文提出了一种数据驱动的接触力估计框架，适用于可变形工具操作（DTM），该框架利用本体感觉传感，无需显式物理模型或工具尖端永久嵌入式传感硬件。首先通过时间模型的对比评估确定了循环架构，其中紧凑型LSTM实现了最低估计误差和亚毫秒级推理延迟。为解决跨未见表面及工具顺应性条件的泛化问题，我们引入了一种参数隔离的小样本自适应策略，通过特征线性调制（FiLM）将低维上下文嵌入增强到冻结的循环骨干网络中。在UR5e平台上针对九种工具-表面交互模式的实验表明，所提方法显著提升了域偏移下的鲁棒性，将零样本估计误差降低多达63%，同时在不发生灾难性遗忘的前提下保持了基线性能。这些结果表明，将共享形变历史动力学与领域特定条件分离，能够实现非平稳环境中DTM的可靠力估计。

Authors: Siavash Mahmoudi, Chaitainya Kuppar Reddy, Yang Tian, Dongyi Wang

Initiation Safety: A Missing Dimension in Generalist-Robot Safety HumanoidEmbodied

initiation authorization generalist-robot safety PAS (probe-authorize-speak) humanoid robot social action consent

简要说明：提出‘启动授权’作为通用机器人中缺失的安全维度，建议设立独立的安全层来决定机器人是否应采取首个难以撤销的社交动作，并在门口人形机器人上实现了PAS（探查-授权-说话）方案。

TLDR: Introduces 'initiation authorization' as a missing safety dimension for generalist robots, proposing a separate safety layer to decide whether a robot should take a first hard-to-undo social action, implemented as PAS (probe-authorize-speak) on a doorway humanoid.

Abstract: Safety for generalist robots is usually discussed in terms of motion or dialogue. We argue a third question is missing: should the robot take its first hard-to-undo social action at all, such as a greeting, an uninvited grasp, or stepping into someone's space? We call this initiation authorization. Current frameworks rarely treat it as a separate safety layer. Today's stacks often skip this step: a high engagement score or a confident VLA rollout is treated as permission to act. But seeing a person is not the same as having their consent to be addressed. We frame initiation authorization within generalist-robot safety and contrast it with post-plan VLA guardrails, implementing PAS (probe-authorize-speak) on a doorway humanoid, comparing it with direct-init on logged traces, and proposing a three-condition user study, with open questions on metrics, governance, and where initiation ends and foundation-model generation begins.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人的安全性通常从运动或对话角度进行讨论。我们认为存在第三个被忽视的问题：机器人是否应当首先执行难以撤销的社交行为，例如问候、未经允许的抓取或踏入他人空间？我们将此称为“启动授权”。现有框架极少将其视为独立的安全层。当前技术栈常跳过这一环节：高参与度评分或高置信度的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型输出即被视作行动许可。但“看见某人”并不等同于“获得被其关注的同意”。我们将启动授权置于通用型机器人安全框架中，并将其与规划后VLA防护机制进行对比，在门廊人形机器人上实现PAS（探测-授权-发声）协议，与日志轨迹中的直接启动进行对比，并提出包含三个条件的用户研究方案，同时探讨度量标准、治理机制以及启动终点与基础模型生成起点之间的界限等开放性问题。

Authors: Zhijin Meng, Francisco Cruz

Behavior Foundations for Quadruped Robots: ABot-C0 Technical Report Locomotion

quadruped robot motion tracking Flow-Matching policy scaling law all-terrain locomotion

简要说明：ABot-C0 为四足机器人提出了一个通用运动控制系统，包含可扩展的多源运动数据管道、展示运动跟踪缩放定律的流匹配策略，以及用于真实世界全地形导航和交互的统一部署栈。

TLDR: ABot-C0 introduces a generalist motion-control system for quadruped robots with a scalable multi-source motion-data pipeline, a Flow-Matching policy showing scaling laws for motion tracking, and a unified deployment stack for real-world all-terrain navigation and interaction.

Abstract: The motion controller is one of the most fundamental modules in embodied intelligence systems. Driven by large-scale human motion-capture data and the motion-tracking paradigm, humanoid control has achieved remarkable progress in recent years. However, migrating this recipe to the quadrupedal setting is far less straightforward: animal motion data is scarcer and harder to capture at scale than human data, and cross-embodiment retargeting remains fragile. We present ABot-C0, a generalist motion-control system for quadruped robots that establishes three complementary behavior foundations: a scalable multi-source motion-data pipeline, robust policy learning across motion tracking, locomotion, and scene interaction, and a unified deployment stack for reliable real-world operation. Fundamentally, we construct a data pyramid through conditional video-generation synthesis, annotated motion capture, teleoperation, and human design, producing 16,074 physically feasible motion clips as the data foundation for diverse motion-learning demands. With large-scale motion data, a Flow-Matching generalist policy demonstrates, for the first time, a scaling law for quadruped motion tracking: performance improves consistently as training scales up, with zero-shot capability to track unseen motions. We then go a step further toward robust all-terrain locomotion by adopting a three-stage privileged-to-perceptive framework with temporal LiDAR memory and terrain-predictive supervision. Collectively, these components form a motion generalist that coordinates multi-policy execution, smooth behavior transitions, energy-efficient control, and safety mechanisms for real-world deployment. Extensive experiments on urban-terrain autonomous navigation and companion-style multimodal interaction demonstrate that quadruped robots can move beyond functional demos toward product-level behavioral intelligence.

摘要（中文）：运动控制器是具身智能系统中最基础的模块之一。在大规模人体运动捕捉数据与运动跟踪范式的驱动下，近年来类人控制取得了显著进展。然而，将该方法迁移至四足场景远非易事：与人类数据相比，动物运动数据更为稀缺且难以大规模捕捉，跨本体重定向技术依然脆弱。本文提出ABot-C0——面向四足机器人的通用运动控制系统，该架构建立了三个互补的行为基础：可扩展的多源运动数据流水线、涵盖运动跟踪、行走与场景交互的鲁棒策略学习，以及确保可靠实际部署的统一化系统集成方案。从底层出发，我们通过条件视频生成合成、带标注的运动捕捉、遥操作与人工设计构建数据金字塔，最终生成16,074个物理可行的运动片段，为多样化运动学习需求奠定数据基础。基于大规模运动数据，流匹配通用策略首次揭示了四足运动跟踪的尺度定律：随着训练规模扩大，性能持续提升，并具备追踪未见运动的零样本能力。我们进一步采用具有时序激光雷达记忆与地形预测监督的三阶段特权-感知框架，实现了鲁棒的全地形行走。这些组件共同构成运动通用系统，通过多策略协同执行、平滑行为过渡、能效控制机制与安全保障功能实现实际部署。城市地形自主导航与伴侣式多模态交互的实验表明，四足机器人已能够超越功能性原型演示，迈向产品级行为智能。

Authors: Xufeng Zhao, Fuzhi Yang, Jianhui Chen, Li Gao, Zhang Meng, Jie Gao, Yao Zheng, Congyang Zhao, Tianxiong Lv, Menglin Yang, Minqi Gu, Yaru Zhao, Wenyu Liu, Honglin Han, Shihui Su, Zixiao Tang, Liu Liu, Mu Xu, Yang Cai, Wenbin Tang

TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

tactile foundation model dexterous manipulation hierarchical policy world model residual refinement

简要说明：TouchWorld提出了一种用于灵巧操作的分层策略，分离了视觉语言规划、触觉世界模型预测和快速触觉反馈，利用触觉同时进行预测和快速校正，在成功率上显著优于基线方法。

TLDR: TouchWorld proposes a hierarchical policy for dexterous manipulation that separates vision-language planning, tactile world-model prediction, and high-frequency tactile feedback, using touch for both anticipation and fast correction, achieving significant success rate improvements over baselines.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation in everyday environments requires both anticipation and reaction: a robot must predict how contact should evolve while rapidly correcting local errors caused by slip, misalignment, unstable grasping, or force mismatch. Vision and language provide semantic and geometric guidance, but they cannot reliably reveal hidden contact states such as force, slip, and contact stability. Although tactile sensing exposes these physical cues, most existing policies treat touch as a low-frequency observation stream within a monolithic action model, coupling slow task reasoning, action generation, and fast contact feedback in a single loop. We introduce TouchWorld, a predictive-and-reactive tactile foundation model for dexterous manipulation. TouchWorld uses a hierarchical policy that separates vision-language subtask planning, tactile world-model prediction, visuo-tactile goal-conditioned action generation, and high-frequency tactile residual refinement. A High-Level Planning Layer produces executable subtasks and predicts tactile subgoals; a Visuo-Tactile Goal-Conditioned Policy generates nominal action chunks; and a Tactile-Conditioned Refinement Policy performs online residual correction using recent tactile and proprioceptive feedback. By using touch as both a predictive contact reference and a fast feedback signal, TouchWorld preserves the semantic generalization of vision-language-action policies while improving local contact adaptation. Across six long-horizon and contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks, TouchWorld achieves 65.0% success in the clean setting and 53.7% success under human perturbations, outperforming the strongest baseline by 15.7 and 18.5 percentage points, respectively.

摘要（中文）：日常环境中的灵巧操作既需要预判也需要反应：机器人必须预测接触应如何演变，同时快速纠正由滑动、错位、抓取不稳或力不匹配引起的局部误差。视觉与语言提供语义和几何引导，但无法可靠揭示力、滑动和接触稳定性等隐藏接触状态。尽管触觉传感能够暴露这些物理线索，现有大多数策略仍将触觉视为单一动作模型中的低频观测流，在单个循环中耦合了缓慢的任务推理、动作生成和快速接触反馈。本文提出TouchWorld——一种用于灵巧操作的预测-反应式触觉基础模型。该模型采用分层策略，将视觉-语言子任务规划、触觉世界模型预测、视觉-触觉目标条件动作生成与高频触觉残差修正相分离。高层规划层生成可执行子任务并预测触觉子目标；视觉-触觉目标条件策略生成名义动作块；触觉条件精化策略利用近期触觉与本体感受反馈执行在线残差修正。通过将触觉同时作为预测性接触参考与快速反馈信号，TouchWorld保留了视觉-语言-动作策略的语义泛化能力，同时提升了局部接触适应性。在六项长时域且富含接触的灵巧操作任务中，TouchWorld在干净环境下成功率达65.0%，在人类扰动下成功率达53.7%，分别比最强基线高出15.7和18.5个百分点。

Authors: Jianyi Zhou, Feiyang Hong, Yunhao Li, Yicheng Zhao, Yongjue Cen, Zirui Liu, Jiakang Huang, Zirui Chen, Ruiyang Zhang, Weizhuo Zhu, Xuhua Song, Shuo Yang

Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators WorldModel

world model certification admissibility ladder action-following closed-loop verdict autonomous driving

简要说明：提出一个可接受性阶梯（L0-L4）用于验证用作机器人学和自动驾驶测试预言的世界模型，论证视觉保真度无法预测闭环判定所需的动作鲁棒性。

TLDR: Proposes an admissibility ladder (L0-L4) for validating world models used as test oracles in robotics and autonomous driving, arguing that visual fidelity does not predict action-robustness needed for trustworthy closed-loop verdicts.

Abstract: Across robotics, World Models (WMs) are increasingly used to evaluate action policies by simulating the consequences of actions in an imagined world, and returning a success or safety verdict. Yet a verdict is only as trustworthy as the WM that produced it, and the WM itself needs to be certified. In video-generation WMs, fidelity metrics such as Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) reward visual realism, but ignore whether the world responds correctly to the policy's actions, including those unseen in training. Classical simulation-based validation assumes a trusted simulator evaluating an untrusted policy, whereas generative WMs are themselves unverified learned artifacts. Hence, we argue that any WM used as a test oracle must first be accredited before its verdicts can serve as evidence. Building on credibility practices from safety-critical simulation, including Verification, Validation & Accreditation (VV&A), Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF), and scenario-based testing standards, we define an admissibility ladder (L0-L4) that a WM must climb before its closed-loop verdicts are accepted as assurance evidence. Our framework is embodiment-agnostic, and is instantiated in autonomous driving (AD), where assurance methods for traditional simulation are most mature. Applied to two driving WMs, the lower rungs reveal a reversal: the model that ranks higher on visual generation quality (L0) ranks lower on action-following (L1-L2), so visual fidelity does not predict the action-robustness a closed-loop verdict depends on.

摘要（中文）：在机器人领域，世界模型日益被用于评估行动策略，方法是在想象世界中模拟行动后果，并返回成功或安全判定。然而，判定的可信度取决于生成该判定的世界模型本身，而世界模型自身也需要通过认证。在视频生成类世界模型中，弗雷歇视频距离等保真度指标奖励视觉真实性，却忽略了世界是否正确响应策略的行动——包括训练中未曾出现的行动。传统的基于仿真的验证假设存在一个可信的仿真器来评估不可信的策略，而生成式世界模型本身就是未经验证的学习产物。因此，我们认为，任何用作测试判官的世界模型，在其判定能够作为证据之前，必须先获得认证。借鉴安全关键仿真中的可信性实践，包括验证、确认与认证、预期功能安全以及基于场景的测试标准，我们定义了一个世界模型必须逐级攀登的可接纳性阶梯（L0-L4），其闭环判定才能被接受为保障证据。该框架与具体具身形态无关，并在自动驾驶领域得到实例化——传统仿真的保障方法在此最为成熟。应用于两个驾驶世界模型时，低层级呈现出一种颠倒：在视觉生成质量（L0）上排名更高的模型，在行动跟随（L1-L2）上排名更低，因此视觉保真度无法预测闭环判定所依赖的行动鲁棒性。

Authors: Christian Oefinger, Finn Rasmus Schäfer, Korbinian Moller, Mattia Piccinini, Johannes Betz

Compositional Motion Generation from Demonstration with Object-Centric Neural Fields Manipulation

learning from demonstration object-centric neural fields temporal mixture-of-experts compositional motion generation manipulation

简要说明：提出一种生成式示范学习框架，通过对象中心神经场与时序混合专家机制实现组合运动生成，在长时程操作任务中实现数据高效的泛化。

TLDR: Proposes a generative learning-from-demonstration framework that combines object-centric neural fields with a temporal mixture-of-experts for compositional motion generation, enabling data-efficient generalization in long-horizon manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Compositionality, by organizing complex behavior as combinations of simpler elements, enables robot learning that is scalable and data efficient. Leveraging this principle, we propose a generative learning-from-demonstration framework that enables compositional modeling of robotic behavior by connecting perception and motion through shared object-level representations. We render scenes from object-centric neural representations that integrate canonical neural fields with latent-conditioned deformations, capturing positional and geometric variations in a smooth, consistent, and interpretable way. For motion generation, a temporal mixture-of-experts (MoE) employs a gating mechanism to combine object-conditioned movement primitives over time, producing complete trajectories. This spatial-temporal compositionality maintains the data efficiency of movement primitives while grounding motion in visual structure, enabling systematic generalization across diverse scene configurations. In simulation, long-horizon manipulation tasks are successfully completed using the proposed model, which requires significantly less training data than other image-based baselines. Real-world experiments further demonstrate the method's robustness to noise, its ability to generalize at the category level through language-based segmentation models, and its capacity to operate directly on 3D scene representations.

摘要（中文）：组合性通过将复杂行为组织为简单元素的组合，使机器人学习具有可扩展性和数据效率。基于这一原理，我们提出了一种生成式学习-从-示范框架，通过共享的物体级表征连接感知与运动，实现对机器人行为的组合式建模。我们利用结合规范神经场与潜在条件变形的物体中心神经表征渲染场景，以平滑、一致且可解释的方式捕捉位置与几何变化。在运动生成方面，时序混合专家模型（MoE）采用门控机制，在时间维度上组合物体条件运动基元，生成完整轨迹。这种时空组合性在保持运动基元数据效率的同时，将运动锚定于视觉结构，实现了跨多样化场景配置的系统性泛化。仿真实验中，所提模型以远少于其他基于图像的基准方法所需的训练数据，成功完成了长时域操作任务。真实世界实验进一步证明了该方法对噪声的鲁棒性、通过基于语言分割模型实现类别级泛化的能力，以及直接在3D场景表征上运行的性能。

Authors: Ahmet Ercan Tekden, Yasemin Bekiroglu

How the Fusion of Onboard Sensors and V2X Data can Improve (or not) the Cooperative Perception of Connected Automated Vehicles AutonomousDriving

Cooperative perception Connected and Automated Vehicles V2X data fusion sensing measurement errors ghost vehicles

简要说明：本文分析了将车载传感器与V2X数据融合对网联自动驾驶车辆协同感知的影响，发现虽然可以扩展感知范围，但V2X误差、数据包丢失和GNSS不准确会引入幽灵车辆等挑战。

TLDR: This paper analyzes how fusing onboard sensors with V2X data affects cooperative perception in connected automated vehicles, finding that while it can extend perception range, challenges like ghost vehicles arise from V2X errors, packet loss, and GNSS inaccuracies.

Abstract: Automated vehicles rely on onboard sensors to perceive their surroundings and navigate autonomously. However, sensor performance may degrade under adverse weather conditions or when line-of-sight is obstructed. Cooperative perception (or collective perception) is expected to mitigate these limitations by enabling Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) to share sensor data and collaboratively enhance situational awareness. Several studies have analyzed the potential of cooperative perception, yet the fusion of V2X data with information from onboard sensors has received limited focus. V2X data may contain errors that affect the quality of the fused data, and hence the effectiveness of cooperative perception. This study analyzes the impact of sensing measurement errors, V2X packet losses, and GNSS inaccuracies on the effectiveness of cooperative perception. The results highlight the potential of cooperative perception to enhance perception levels and range compared to using onboard sensors alone. However, they also identify key challenges related to the generation of ghost vehicles during the fusion process, which must be addressed to prevent V2X data from introducing additional errors when fused with onboard sensor data.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶汽车依靠车载传感器感知周围环境并实现自主导航。然而，在恶劣天气条件下或视线受阻时，传感器性能可能下降。协同感知（或称集体感知）有望通过使网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）共享传感器数据并协同增强态势感知来缓解这些局限性。已有若干研究分析了协同感知的潜力，但关于V2X数据与车载传感器信息融合的研究较为有限。V2X数据可能包含影响融合数据质量的误差，进而影响协同感知的有效性。本研究分析了传感测量误差、V2X数据包丢失以及GNSS定位不准确性对协同感知有效性的影响。结果表明，相较于单独使用车载传感器，协同感知在提升感知水平和感知范围方面具有潜力。然而，研究也指出了融合过程中产生虚拟车辆的关键挑战，必须解决这一问题，以避免V2X数据在与车载传感器数据融合时引入额外误差。

Authors: Amir Mohammadisarab, Miguel Sepulcre, Luca Lusvarghi, Javier Gozalvez

GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation Manipulation

geometric grounding proprioception-vision alignment Diffusion Policy FiLM modulation generalist manipulation

简要说明：GeoProp 提出了一种即插即用的适配器，通过将机器人状态几何地投影到图像平面进行局部特征采样和调制，从而将本体感觉与视觉对齐，在 67 个任务上提升操作策略性能。

TLDR: GeoProp introduces a plug-and-play adapter that geometrically grounds robot proprioception into vision by projecting state onto the image plane for localized feature sampling and modulation, improving manipulation policies across 67 tasks.

Abstract: Proprioception is fundamental to robotic manipulation, yet standard fusion methods often treat it as an isolated vector lacking explicit alignment with visual tokens. Without a direct correspondence between 3D kinematics and 2D feature maps, manipulation policies struggle to ground the robot's state within the scene, frequently underperforming even vision-only baselines. To address this, we introduce GeoProp, a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter that aligns proprioception with vision through explicit geometric grounding and spatial feature sampling. GeoProp projects the robot state onto the image plane to sample localized visual features, constructing a grounded state token. It then injects state-derived spatial priors into the corresponding visual features via FiLM modulation. To capture motion intent, GeoProp further samples features at a short-horizon predicted coordinate derived from recent kinematics, providing look-ahead visual context. Across 67 tasks, GeoProp improves Diffusion Policy by 8.7% on 63 simulation tasks and pi_0 by 4.0% on the RoboTwin subset, and yields a 10.6% average gain across both policy families in the real world, while adding only 2-3% to the parameter count. These results demonstrate that GeoProp is a simple yet high-impact inductive bias for generalist embodied policies. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/GeoProp/.

摘要（中文）：本体感知是机器人操作的基础，但标准融合方法常将其视为与视觉标记缺乏显式对齐的孤立向量。由于三维运动学与二维特征图之间缺乏直接对应关系，操作策略难以将机器人的状态锚定在场景中，其性能甚至常不及纯视觉基线方法。为解决这一问题，我们提出GeoProp——一种轻量级的即插即用适配器，通过显式几何定位与空间特征采样实现本体感知与视觉的对齐。GeoProp将机器人状态投影至图像平面，对局部视觉特征进行采样，从而构建具有空间定位的状态标记；随后通过FiLM调制将状态导出的空间先验注入对应的视觉特征中。为捕捉运动意图，GeoProp进一步基于近期运动学数据在短时域预测坐标处采样特征，提供前瞻性视觉上下文。在总计67项任务中，GeoProp将Diffusion Policy在63项仿真任务上提升8.7%，将pi_0在RoboTwin子集上提升4.0%；在真实世界场景中，两类策略家族的平均增益达10.6%，而参数量仅增加2-3%。这些结果表明，GeoProp是一种简洁高效的归纳偏置方法，适用于通用具身策略。项目页面：https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/GeoProp/。

Authors: Guoyang Zhao, Quanhao Qian, Gongjie Zhang, Wenhao Li, Jiuniu Wang, Xiaowei Lu, Deli Zhao, Ran Xu

PriGo: Test-Time Primitive Guidance to Diffusion and Flow Policies for Adaptive Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

test-time adaptation primitive guidance diffusion policies flow policies robotic manipulation

简要说明：PriGo 提出了一种测试时的原始动作指导框架，用于扩散和流策略，无需重新训练即可自适应地提升机器人操作在任务和环境中的泛化能力。

TLDR: PriGo proposes a test-time primitive-guided framework for diffusion and flow policies that adapts robotic manipulation without retraining, improving generalization across tasks and environments.

Abstract: Imitation learning has enabled remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, especially with diffusion and flow-based policies that generate complex visuomotor behaviors directly from demonstrations. Yet, despite their strong performance, these policies often fail to generalize across tasks and environments. A key reason is that existing policies tend to imitate superficial action correlations rather than the underlying intent. Inspired by the compositional structure of human behaviors, we propose PriGo, a primitive-guided test-time adaptive framework for robust robotic manipulation. PriGo introduces PANet, a lightweight primitive prediction module that infers primitive distributions directly from observations. We further propose a differentiable primitive guidance mechanism that refines generated actions during inference, steering trajectories toward semantically consistent behaviors. Unlike prior primitive-conditioned approaches, PriGo operates entirely at test time and can be seamlessly integrated into pretrained diffusion and flow policies without retraining. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, CALVIN, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that PriGo consistently improves robustness, long-horizon execution, and generalization ability across both diffusion and flow-based policies.

摘要（中文）：模仿学习已在机器人操作领域取得了显著进展，尤其是基于扩散和流策略的方法，能够直接从演示中生成复杂的视觉运动行为。然而，尽管这些策略表现出色，它们往往难以跨任务和跨环境进行泛化。关键原因在于现有策略倾向于模仿浅层的动作相关性，而非潜在的意图。受人类行为组合结构的启发，我们提出了PriGo——一种基于原语引导的测试时自适应框架，用于实现鲁棒的机器人操作。PriGo引入了PANet，这是一个轻量级的原语预测模块，能够直接从观测中推断原语分布。我们进一步提出了一种可微的原语引导机制，在推理过程中优化生成的动作，将轨迹引导至语义一致的行为。与以往依赖原语条件的方法不同，PriGo完全在测试时运行，可无缝集成至预训练的扩散和流策略中，无需重新训练。在LIBERO、CALVIN、SIMPLER以及真实世界机器人任务上的大量实验表明，PriGo在基于扩散和流的策略上均能持续提升其鲁棒性、长时域执行能力以及泛化性能。

Authors: Zezeng Li, Enda Xiang, Thuy Tran, Di Huang, Momath Thiam, Liming Chen

A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Robust Multi-Robot Manipulation Manipulation

multi-robot manipulation LLM-based framework closed-loop verification hierarchical agents adaptive tool use

简要说明：一个基于大语言模型的分层闭环智能体框架，通过专门化的规划、操作和验证智能体实现鲁棒的多机器人操作，并在真实世界中验证。

TLDR: A hierarchical closed-loop LLM-based framework with specialized agents for robust multi-robot manipulation, validated on real-world tasks.

Abstract: Multi-robot systems provide the parallelism and redundancy necessary for long-horizon tasks, while Large Language Models (LLMs) offer the reasoning capabilities to decompose these objectives into actionable plans. However, effectively grounding this high-level reasoning in physical multi-robot execution remains an open challenge. Existing LLM-based approaches fall mainly into two categories: Single-robot methods achieve robust contact-rich manipulation but lack the coordination mechanisms required for tasks spanning multiple workspaces. Current multi-robot frameworks focus on high-level planning, often treating manipulation as an idealized primitive that fails to account for real-world execution uncertainties. To address this, we propose a hierarchical closed-loop agentic LLM-based framework to ensure robust multi-robot manipulation. Our system consists of three specialized agents: the Planning Agent decomposes instructions into allocated sub-tasks, the Manipulation Agent for each robot executes actions via adaptive tool use, and the Verification Agent closes the loop by monitoring physical outcomes and feeding back semantic corrections. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves superior success rates, ensures robust adaptability ranging from single to cross workspace manipulation, and offers a generalizable approach for diverse manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：多机器人系统为长周期任务提供了所需的并行性与冗余能力，而大语言模型则具备将此类目标分解为可执行方案的推理能力。然而，如何将这种高层推理有效落地于物理多机器人执行仍是一个开放挑战。现有基于大语言模型的方法主要分为两类：单机器人方法虽能实现稳健的接触式操控，但缺乏跨多工作空间任务所需的协调机制；当前多机器人框架则聚焦高层规划，往往将操控视为理想化基元，未能考虑实际执行中的不确定性。为解决该问题，我们提出了一种基于分层闭环智能体的大语言模型框架，以确保稳健的多机器人操控。该系统由三类专用智能体构成：规划智能体将指令分解为分配子任务，各机器人的操控智能体通过自适应工具使用执行动作，验证智能体则通过监测物理结果并反馈语义修正形成闭环。大规模真实世界实验表明，本框架在成功率上表现优越，具备从单工作空间到跨工作空间操控的稳健自适应能力，并为多样化操控任务提供了可泛化的解决方案。

Authors: Yi-Xiang He, Lan Wei, Haoming Cen, Jian-Jian Jiang, Zhuohao Li, Guanxing Lu, Yihan Yang, Dandan Zhang, Wei-Shi Zheng

Flow-ERD: Agent-type Aware Flow Matching with Entropy-Regularized Distillation for Diverse Traffic Simulation AutonomousDriving

traffic simulation flow matching entropy-regularized distillation multi-agent autonomous driving

简要说明：Flow-ERD 提出了一种结合熵正则化蒸馏的智能体类型感知流匹配方法，以生成多样且真实的多智能体交通仿真，用于自动驾驶。

TLDR: Flow-ERD proposes an agent-type aware flow matching method combined with entropy-regularized distillation to generate diverse and realistic multi-agent traffic simulations for autonomous driving.

Abstract: Realistic and diverse traffic simulation is essential to autonomous driving development. Yet prevailing benchmarks predominantly reward realism, and recent methods have optimized accordingly, leaving diversity underexplored. We introduce \textbf{Flow-ERD}, a multi-agent simulator that pursues realism and diversity jointly. Its backbone, \textbf{Agent-Type Aware Flow Matching} (AFM), couples flow matching's multi-modal expressiveness with type-specific kinematic execution. It preserves fine-grained diversity while keeping motions consistent with each agent type. A second stage, \textbf{Entropy-Regularized Distillation} (ERD), fine-tunes the closed-loop rollout distribution with an entropy-regularized reverse-KL objective. This mitigates covariate shift while explicitly preventing collapse onto high-density modes. We evaluate Flow-ERD with a log-free diversity metric alongside standard realism scores. Flow-ERD ranks first on the WOSAC test benchmark and dominates the realism--diversity Pareto front among reproducible baselines. Our project page is available \href{https://seulbinhwang.github.io/flow-erd-project-page/}{here}.

摘要（中文）：真实且多样化的交通仿真对于自动驾驶开发至关重要。然而，现有基准测试主要奖励真实性，近期方法也据此进行了优化，导致多样性探索不足。我们提出 **Flow-ERD**，一种同时追求真实性与多样性的多智能体仿真器。其主干网络 **智能体类型感知流匹配**（AFM）将流匹配的多模态表达能力与各类型运动学执行相结合，在保持各智能体类型运动一致性的同时保留细粒度多样性。第二阶段 **熵正则化蒸馏**（ERD）通过熵正则化的反向KL散度目标对闭环展开分布进行微调，在缓解协变量偏移的同时明确防止向高密度模式坍缩。我们采用无日志多样性指标及标准真实性评分对Flow-ERD进行评估。Flow-ERD在WOSAC测试基准中排名第一，并在可复现基线中主导了真实性-多样性帕累托前沿。项目页面见\href{https://seulbinhwang.github.io/flow-erd-project-page/}{此处}。

Authors: Seulbin Hwang, Kiyoung Om, Daejung Kim, Jinhan Lee

GemNav: Discrete-Token Visual Robot Navigation using a Multimodal Large Language Model VLN

visual navigation Multimodal Large Language Model Low-Rank Adaptation discrete-token adaptation zero-shot transfer

简要说明：GemNav 仅通过语言塔的低秩适配（LoRA）冻结的多模态大语言模型用于视觉机器人航点导航，在极少量训练数据下实现零样本迁移到未知环境。

TLDR: GemNav adapts a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model for visual robot waypoint navigation using only LoRA on the language tower, achieving zero-shot transfer to unseen environments with minimal training data.

Abstract: Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models have so far followed a common recipe: a dedicated visual encoder, a bespoke action head, and training on thousands of hours of cross-embodiment datasets. We ask whether this recipe is necessary. In this paper, we introduce GemNav, a visual robot navigation policy that adapts a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for short-to-medium horizon waypoint navigation using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on the language tower alone, with no auxiliary visual encoder and no continuous regression head. Waypoints and categorical navigation signals share a single discrete token vocabulary generated by the language-model head, and a soft-decoded auxiliary loss recovers the metric structure that pure cross-entropy training discards. On a single 8.7-hour open corpus, roughly three orders of magnitude smaller than competing training sets, the policy transfers zero-shot to four physically distinct unseen environments and stops within 0.25-0.42m of the goal across 20 real-world trials covering an open carpark, an obstacle carpark, a long outdoor chemical yard, and an indoor warehouse. Conditioning on short image histories improves offline metrics but yields no robot benefit, pointing to a ceiling on what temporal context adds once pretrained vision features are in place. These results indicate that discrete-token adaptation of frozen MLLMs can provide a data-efficient, deployable alternative for foundation model robot navigation.

摘要（中文）：基于大型预训练模型构建的视觉导航策略至今遵循一个通用范式：专用视觉编码器、定制化动作头，以及基于数千小时跨实体数据集进行训练。我们质疑这一范式是否必要。本文提出GemNav——一种视觉机器人导航策略，该策略仅通过语言塔的低秩适配（LoRA）来适配冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM），实现中短距离航点导航，无需辅助视觉编码器与连续回归头。航点与分类导航信号共享由语言模型头生成的单一离散词元词汇表，而软解码辅助损失函数可恢复纯交叉熵训练所丢弃的度量结构。基于仅8.7小时的单一开放语料库（规模约为竞争性训练集的千分之一），该策略在四个物理环境迥异且未见过的场景中实现零样本迁移，并在涵盖露天停车场、障碍停车场、室外长距离化工场及室内仓库的20项实景测试中，将终点误差控制在0.25-0.42米范围内。基于短时序图像历史的条件化输入虽能改善离线指标，但未带来机器人实测性能提升，这表明当预训练视觉特征就位后，时间上下文信息的增益存在瓶颈。上述结果表明，冻结MLLM的离散词元适配策略可为基础模型机器人导航提供一种数据高效且可部署的替代方案。

Authors: Peter Bohm, Saimunur Rahman, Abdelwahed Khamis, Sagun Man Singh Shrestha, Chris McCool, Peyman Moghadam

RoboSnap: One-Shot Real-to-Sim Scene Generation for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation RLRobot

real-to-sim scene generation robot learning simulation policy evaluation

简要说明：RoboSnap 通过分层设计从单张 RGB 图像生成可用于仿真的场景，分离物理关键的交互区域与视觉背景，从而实现可泛化的机器人学习和可复现的策略评估。

TLDR: RoboSnap generates simulation-ready scenes from a single RGB image using a layered design that separates physics-critical foreground from visual background, enabling generalizable robot learning and reproducible policy evaluation.

Abstract: Recovering real-world scenes as interactive simulation environments can enable generalizable robot learning and reproducible policy evaluation. However, constructing scenes that are both physically stable and visually faithful remains slow and expensive. In this work, we present RoboSnap, a real-to-sim framework that turns a single RGB image into a simulation-ready scene. The key idea is a layered design that separates the physics-critical interaction area from the surrounding visual context: collision-aware foreground assets are refined for stable robot interaction, while a 3D Gaussian splatting visual layer preserves faithful background appearance under novel views. Experiments on DROID scenes and real-robot tasks show that RoboSnap achieves reliable trajectory replay in the recovered scenes, supports task-specific synthetic data generation for policy training, and yields meaningful sim-real correlation for policy evaluation. To further support real-to-sim research, we introduce DROID-Sim, a real-to-sim companion dataset constructed from 564 real-world scenes in DROID. Extensive experiments suggest that the value of real-to-sim methods lies not only in high-fidelity visual reconstruction, but in turning real environments into reusable infrastructure for robot learning and evaluation.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 将真实场景重建为交互式仿真环境，能够支持可泛化的机器人学习与可复现的策略评估。然而，构建既物理稳定又视觉保真的场景依然耗时且成本高昂。本文提出RoboSnap——一种“真实到仿真”框架，能够将单张RGB图像转化为可直接用于仿真的场景。其核心思想采用分层设计，将物理关键交互区域与周围视觉背景分离：碰撞感知的前景资产经过精细化处理以支持稳定的机器人交互，而3D高斯泼溅视觉层则在新视角下保留逼真的背景外观。在DROID场景及真实机器人任务上的实验表明，RoboSnap能在重建场景中实现可靠的轨迹复现，支持面向策略训练的任务特定合成数据生成，并产生有意义的仿真-真实相关性以用于策略评估。为进一步推动真实到仿真研究，我们推出了DROID-Sim——基于DROID中564个真实场景构建的真实到仿真配套数据集。大量实验表明，真实到仿真方法的价值不仅在于高保真视觉重建，更在于将真实环境转化为可复用的机器人学习与评估基础设施。

Authors: Shujie Zhang, Jingkun Yi, Weipeng Zhong, Zirui Zhou, Yangkun Zhu, Hanqing Wang, Xudong Xu, Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen

NativeMEM: Native Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation VLA

memory compression long-horizon VLA manipulation tokenization

简要说明：NativeMEM提出了一种内存压缩方案，利用VLA自身的视觉编码器将历史帧压缩为单个token，从而在低延迟下实现机器人操作的长期视觉记忆。

TLDR: NativeMEM proposes a memory compression scheme that repurposes the VLA's own vision encoder to condense historical frames into single tokens, enabling long-horizon visual memory with low latency for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: How can pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models retain long-horizon visual histories with high-frequency updates without sacrificing efficiency? Existing approaches rely on external memory management, which restrains either the memory horizon or the reactiveness of pretrained policies. To this end, we present NativeMEM, a VLA policy that features long-term and real-time updated memory. At its core is an efficient memory encoding scheme, Native Memory Compression, which repurposes the VLA's own vision encoder to compress each historical frame from each camera view into a single token. Appended to the input sequence, these memory tokens enable the pretrained VLA to attend over long-term history with negligible latency overhead, requiring neither an external planner nor a freshly initialized memory module. To align the memory tokens with the pretrained policy, we first develop a generic memory tokenizer under the supervision of a frozen VLA on memory-demanding data, and then unfreeze the VLA for task-specific fine-tuning. NativeMEM consistently outperforms prior methods, boosting success rates from 32.4% to 84.0% in simulation and up to 98.7% on real robots, while maintaining low inference latency and GPU memory usage. Notably, NativeMEM exhibits high data efficiency by achieving competitive results with prior arts using only 20% of the training data.

摘要（中文）：预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如何在保持高频更新的同时，保留长时间跨度的视觉历史记录且不牺牲效率？现有方法依赖外部记忆管理，这限制了预训练策略的记忆跨度或响应能力。为此，我们提出NativeMEM——一种具备长期、实时更新记忆功能的VLA策略。其核心是一种高效的记忆编码方案——原生记忆压缩（Native Memory Compression），该方案利用VLA自身的视觉编码器，将每个摄像头视角的每一帧历史图像压缩为单个标记。这些记忆标记被附加到输入序列中，使预训练VLA能够以可忽略的延迟开销关注长期历史，无需外部规划器或全新初始化的记忆模块。为使记忆标记与预训练策略对齐，我们首先在需要高记忆负荷的数据上，借助冻结的VLA监督训练通用记忆分词器，随后解冻VLA进行任务特定微调。NativeMEM在各项指标上均优于先前方法：模拟环境中成功率从32.4%提升至84.0%，真实机器人场景中最高达98.7%，同时保持低推理延迟和低GPU内存占用。值得注意的是，NativeMEM展现出高数据效率——仅使用20%的训练数据即可达到与先前方法相匹敌的结果。

Authors: Ziye Wang, Modi Shi, Chaojun Ni, Jiazhi Yang, Mengdi Li, Zhizhong Su, Tianwei Lin, Hongyang Li

Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence WorldModel

Mixture-of-Experts video pretraining embodied intelligence DiT world dynamics

简要说明：LingBot-Video是一种专为具身智能设计的混合专家视频DiT预训练范式，通过机器人相关数据和多维奖励系统桥接视频生成与物理执行。

TLDR: LingBot-Video is a Mixture-of-Experts video DiT pretraining paradigm designed for embodied intelligence, using robot-oriented data and a multi-dimensional reward system to bridge video generation and physical actuation.

Abstract: Despite the recent promise in robot control, video generative models suffer from a domain mismatch due to their primary focus on content creation. For example, their design inherently prioritizes visual fidelity and creativity over computational efficiency and physical realism. In this work, we present LingBot-Video, a DiT-based video pretraining paradigm specifically tailored for embodied intelligence. From the architecture perspective, we adopt the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), instead of dense, framework to achieve a better trade-off between modeling capacity and inference efficiency, and manage to scale it up from scratch. From the data perspective, we construct a data profiling engine that augments standard internet videos with extensive robot-oriented footage, encompassing manipulation, navigation, and egocentric perspectives, to equip the base model with an intrinsic understanding of actions and world dynamics. From the training perspective, we develop a multi-dimensional reward system to enforce the alignment regarding physical rationality and task completion, going beyond standard criteria such as aesthetics, prompt-following, and motion consistency. Comprehensive evaluations validate its performance and efficiency as a video foundation model. We contribute LingBot-Video as the inaugural large-scale, open-source MoE video foundation model to the community, in a pioneering effort to bridge digital creativity and physical actuation.

摘要（中文）：尽管机器人控制领域近期取得了进展，但视频生成模型因其主要聚焦于内容创作而面临领域不匹配的问题。例如，其设计本质上是优先考虑视觉保真度和创造力，而非计算效率与物理真实性。在这项工作中，我们提出了LingBot-Video——一种专为具身智能设计的基于DiT的视频预训练范式。在架构层面，我们采用混合专家（MoE）框架而非密集框架，以更好地平衡建模能力与推理效率，并成功实现了从零开始的规模化扩展。在数据层面，我们构建了一个数据剖析引擎，通过将大量面向机器人的素材——涵盖操作、导航和第一人称视角——与标准互联网视频相结合，使基础模型能够内在地理解动作与世界动态。在训练层面，我们开发了多维奖励系统，以强化物理合理性与任务完成度方面的对齐效果，超越了对美感、遵循指令和运动一致性等传统标准的考量。全面评估验证了其作为视频基础模型的性能与效率。我们将LingBot-Video作为业界首个大规模开源MoE视频基础模型贡献给社区，以此开创性地弥合数字创造力与物理驱动之间的鸿沟。

Authors: Shuailei Ma, Jiaqi Liao, Xinyang Wang, Jingjing Wang, Chaoran Feng, Zijing Hu, Chong Bao, Zichen Xi, Yuqi Gan, Weisen Wang, Yanhong Zeng, Qin Zhao, Zifan Shi, Wei Wu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Shangzhan Zhang, Jiahao Shao, Yipengjing Sun, Liangxiao Hu, Lunke Pan, Nan Xue, Kecheng Zheng, Yinghao Xu, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Ka Leong Cheng

WildCity: A Real-World City-Scale Testbed for Rendering, Simulation, and Spatial Intelligence AutonomousDriving

city-scale dataset autonomous fleets closed-loop simulator urban digital twins spatial intelligence

简要说明：WildCity 提供了由自动驾驶车队采集的真实城市规模多模态数据集，并建立了重建基线和闭环模拟器，旨在推动面向具身智能和自动驾驶的城市级空间智能。

TLDR: WildCity provides a real-world city-scale multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets, together with a reconstruction baseline and closed-loop simulator, aimed at advancing urban-scale spatial intelligence for embodied AI and autonomous driving.

Abstract: Humans can navigate an unfamiliar city and gradually form a coherent spatial mental map spanning tens of square kilometers. Can AI build spatial representations at a comparable scale? Although recent foundation models have advanced scene reconstruction and embodied intelligence, scaling to entire cities remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of city-scale data. To bridge the gap, we introduce WildCity, a real-world multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets traversing complex urban environments. Our dataset includes 18 trajectories, each averaging 83.7 kilometers in length, and preserves the core challenges of in-the-wild perception, e.g., dynamic objects, lighting variations, and imperfect camera poses. We further establish an urban-tailored reconstruction baseline and convert the reconstructed environments into a closed-loop simulator. Beyond the dataset and baseline, we systematically analyze the key challenges on the path to simulation-ready urban digital twins: scalability, extrapolation, and uncertainty. Ultimately, WildCity aims to catalyze progress not only in city-scale rendering, but more broadly in the pursuit of AI that can perceive, remember, and reason across space at a scale comparable to human cognition. Project page: https://han-xiangyu.github.io/Wild-City/

摘要（中文）：人类能够在不熟悉的城市中导航，并逐步形成覆盖数十平方公里的连贯空间心理地图。人工智能能否构建同等规模的空间表征？尽管近期的基础模型推动了场景重建与具身智能的发展，但扩展至整个城市规模仍是一个未解决的挑战，主要原因在于缺乏城市级数据。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了WildCity——一个由穿越复杂城市环境的自动驾驶车队采集的真实世界多模态数据集。该数据集包含18条轨迹，每条平均长度83.7公里，并保留了野外感知的核心挑战，例如动态物体、光照变化以及不完美的相机位姿。我们进一步建立了一个面向城市环境的定制化重建基线，并将重建环境转换为闭环仿真器。除数据集与基线外，我们系统分析了迈向仿真就绪的城市数字孪生过程中的关键挑战：可扩展性、外推能力与不确定性。最终，WildCity旨在不仅推动城市级渲染的进步，更广泛促进人工智能在空间感知、记忆与推理能力上接近人类认知水平的探索。项目主页：https://han-xiangyu.github.io/Wild-City/

Authors: Xiangyu Han, Mengyu Yang, Jiaqi Li, Bowen Chang, Ziyu Chen, Hexu Zhao, Rahul Kumar Agrawal, Anthony Rodriguez, Fiona Hua, Marco Pavone, Chen Feng, Yiming Li

A knowledge-augmented dataset of high-risk driving scenarios with LLM annotations for autonomous driving AutonomousDriving

high-risk driving scenarios LLM annotations trajectory dataset autonomous driving semantic annotations

简要说明：K-Risk是一个知识增强的数据集，结合了20个驾驶轨迹数据集和LLM生成的语义标注，提供31,398个高风险驾驶事件（包括近碰撞案例），用于开发风险感知的自动驾驶智能体。

TLDR: K-Risk is a knowledge-augmented dataset combining 20 driving trajectory datasets with LLM-generated semantic annotations to provide 31,398 high-risk driving events, including near-collision cases, for developing risk-aware autonomous driving agents.

Abstract: Safe autonomous driving requires both rapid responses to common high-risk events and deeper reasoning over rare, extreme long-tail scenarios in traffic safety. These scenarios are severely under-represented in naturalistic driving data, and existing trajectory and language-augmented datasets seldom provide high-risk event labels, semantic annotations, and verifiable safety signals. Here we present K-Risk, a knowledge-augmented dataset that combines structured driving trajectories with large language model generated semantic annotations for safety-critical driving scenarios. K-Risk integrates 20 human-driven and autonomous-vehicle trajectory datasets from Europe, China, and the United States, covering highways, urban freeways, intersections, and roundabouts. Using a unified risk-centric extraction pipeline, K-Risk curates 31,398 high-risk events, together with a 1,036-event extreme subset of near-collision cases. Each event is released as a synchronized trajectory, metadata, and language triplet containing structured scenario descriptions, abnormal-behavior notifications, and, for a representative subset, causal risk analyses and action recommendations validated through a closed-loop simulator with iterative reflection. By combining multi-dimensional risk annotations, interpretable language supervision, and verifiable decisions, K-Risk bridges structured traffic trajectories, semantic reasoning, and decision supervision, providing a standardized foundation for developing and evaluating next-generation risk-aware autonomous driving agents.

摘要（中文）：安全自动驾驶要求系统既能对常见高风险事件做出快速响应，也能对交通安全中罕见、极端的"长尾场景"进行深度推理。这类场景在自然驾驶数据中严重缺乏代表性，现有轨迹数据集及语言增强数据集也很少提供高风险事件标签、语义标注以及可验证的安全信号。为此，我们提出K-Risk——一种知识增强型数据集，它结合了结构化驾驶轨迹与大语言模型生成的语义标注，专门针对安全关键型驾驶场景。K-Risk整合了来自欧洲、中国和美国的20个人工驾驶与自动驾驶车辆轨迹数据集，覆盖高速公路、城市快速路、交叉路口和环岛等场景。通过统一的风险中心化提取流程，K-Risk精选出31,398个高风险事件，并从中提取出包含1,036个事件的濒临碰撞极端子集。每个事件以同步轨迹、元数据和语言三元组的形式发布，包含结构化场景描述、异常行为通知，并针对代表性子集提供因果风险分析及通过闭环模拟器经迭代反思验证的行动建议。通过融合多维度风险标注、可解释语言监督与可验证决策，K-Risk连接了结构化交通轨迹、语义推理与决策监督，为开发与评估下一代具备风险感知能力的自动驾驶智能体提供了标准化基础。

Authors: Heye Huang, Jingguang Li, Zhiyuan Zhou, Paul Liang, Mingyu Wu, Kitae Jang, Jianqiang Wang

Generating Personalized Lower-Limb Kinematics Across Walking Speeds Using Subject-Conditioned Diffusion Locomotion

subject-conditioned diffusion residual diffusion lower-limb kinematics exoskeleton personalization gait generation

简要说明：提出一种基于残差扩散的个性化下肢运动生成框架，仅需一个速度的步态数据即可生成其他速度下的运动，显著降低外骨骼个性化所需的数据采集负担。

TLDR: A subject-conditioned residual diffusion model generates personalized lower-limb kinematics at unseen walking speeds from minimal gait data, reducing data collection burden for exoskeleton personalization.

Abstract: Personalizing exoskeleton assistance requires user-specific gait data across many locomotor tasks, yet collecting this data demands repeated motion capture sessions that are costly, time-intensive, and especially burdensome for clinical populations. This challenge is most acute across walking speeds, where gait changes substantially and deviates further in clinical gait. This work introduces a subject-conditioned residual diffusion framework that generates personalized lower-limb kinematics at unseen walking speeds from a subject's gait sequence at a single seen speed. Given sagittal-plane hip, knee, and ankle trajectories at a seen speed and a desired unseen speed, the model generates a residual that transforms the seen trajectory into the unseen one, using a transformer denoiser conditioned on the subject's gait and the two speeds through feature-wise linear modulation. Trained only on able-bodied data, the model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 3.4° on held-out able-bodied subjects. Without any stroke-specific fine-tuning, it achieved a 6.0° MAE on out-of-training-distribution stroke subjects, retaining subject identity for clinical gait. The framework reduced the MAE by over 70% relative to supervised feed-forward baselines, and a single seen speed matched the accuracy of four speeds within 0.4°. These results demonstrate that subject-conditioned residual diffusion can synthesize personalized gait across speeds from minimal data, reducing the collection burden for downstream exoskeleton personalization.

摘要（中文）：个性化外骨骼辅助需要在多种运动任务中获取用户特定的步态数据，然而采集这些数据需要反复进行运动捕捉，成本高昂、耗时漫长，对临床人群尤为困难。这一挑战在步行速度变化时最为突出——步态会随速度显著改变，且在临床步态中偏离程度更大。本研究提出一种基于受试者条件的残差扩散框架，能够从受试者在单一已知速度下的步态序列，生成其在未见速度下的个性化下肢运动学数据。给定已知速度下的矢状面髋、膝、踝轨迹以及目标未见速度后，该模型通过特征线性调制，以受试者步态及两个速度为条件，利用基于变换器的去噪器生成残差，将已知速度轨迹转换为未见速度轨迹。仅在健全受试者数据上训练的模型，在保留的健全受试者上实现了3.4°的平均绝对误差（MAE）；在分布外的脑卒中受试者上，无需任何针对中风的微调即达到了6.0°的MAE，并保持了临床步态的受试者个体特征。相较于有监督前馈基线模型，该框架将MAE降低了超过70%，且仅使用单一已知速度即可达到使用四种速度时精度（相差0.4°以内）。这些结果表明，受试者条件的残差扩散能够从极少量数据中合成跨速度的个性化步态，从而降低下游外骨骼个性化所需的数据采集负担。

Authors: Diya Dinesh, Adrian Krieger, Changseob Song, Dongho Park, Aaron J. Young, Inseung Kang

Smooth Operator: A Real-Time Sampling-Based Algorithm for Kinematic Hand Retargeting Manipulation

sampling-based retargeting kinematic hand retargeting teleoperation dexterous manipulation gradient-free

简要说明：本文提出一种无梯度的、基于采样的运动学手部重定向算法（SBR），用于遥操作，实现了低抖动和实时性能，并通过用户研究验证了其在提升任务成功率和降低操作者疲劳方面的优势。

TLDR: This paper presents a gradient-free, sampling-based retargeting algorithm (SBR) for kinematic hand retargeting in teleoperation, achieving low-jitter and real-time performance, validated by a user study showing improved success rate and reduced operator fatigue.

Abstract: Advances in learning-based robotic manipulation, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and Video Action Models (VAMs), heavily rely on high-quality teleoperation data. Their capabilities are strictly upper-bounded by the quality of the underlying human demonstrations. Current gradient-based retargeting algorithms often converge to different local minima, resulting in jitter that affects data quality and teleoperation experience. To address this, we introduce the Sampling-Based Retargeter (SBR), a novel gradient-free retargeting method drawn from the rich literature of sampling-based control and explicitly designed for low-jitter, real-time kinematic retargeting. We evaluate SBR both in simulation and through a rigorous real-world user study involving 18 participants performing 3 complex manipulation tasks. Compared to gradient-based baselines, SBR achieved the highest overall task success rate (54.1%) while significantly reducing operator cognitive fatigue, recording the lowest NASA-TLX workload score (36.4 out of 100). Ultimately, we establish SBR as a highly effective, intuitive retargeter for dexterous manipulation, providing the community with a rigorous benchmarking methodology to guide future retargeting research.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的机器人操作技术（如视觉-语言-动作模型和视频动作模型）的进步高度依赖高质量遥操作数据。其能力严格受限于底层人类演示的质量。当前基于梯度的重定向算法常收敛于不同的局部最小值，导致抖动现象，影响数据质量和遥操作体验。为解决这一问题，我们提出基于采样的重定向器（SBR），这是一种从丰富的采样控制文献中提取的新型无梯度重定向方法，专为低抖动、实时运动学重定向设计。我们通过仿真及一项包含18名参与者执行3项复杂操作任务的严格真实世界用户研究对SBR进行了评估。与基于梯度的基线方法相比，SBR实现了最高总体任务成功率（54.1%），同时显著降低了操作者的认知疲劳，并记录了最低的NASA-TLX工作负荷评分（满分100分中仅36.4分）。最终，我们将SBR确立为一种用于灵巧操作的高效、直观重定向方法，为社区提供严格的基准测试方法以指导未来重定向研究。

Authors: Robert Jomar Malate, Erik Bauer, Norica Bacuieti, Stefanos Charalambous, Elvis Nava, Robert K. Katzschmann, Benedek Forrai

Immersive Social Interaction with VR and LLM-Assisted Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

immersive teleoperation humanoid robot LLM VR manipulation multimodal data collection

简要说明：提出了一套结合VR与LLM的人形机器人遥操作框架，利用Apple Vision Pro提供视觉反馈、语音控制移动和手部动作重定向，在Unitree H1上进行了操作与社交任务验证。

TLDR: A VR+LLM teleoperation framework for humanoid robots using Apple Vision Pro for visual feedback, voice-controlled locomotion, and hand-motion retargeting, evaluated on a Unitree H1 humanoid in manipulation and social tasks.

Abstract: Humanoid robots can extend human presence to remote, constrained, or hazardous environments, but existing teleoperation interfaces often require physically demanding motion tracking or cognitively demanding low-level control. This paper presents an immersive teleoperation framework that integrates voice-controlled locomotion, VR-based manipulation, and bidirectional social interaction for whole-body humanoid control. Using Apple Vision Pro, the operator receives egocentric visual feedback, issues natural-language locomotion commands, and teleoperates the robot's arms and dexterous hands through wrist and finger tracking. An LLM-assisted voice-control module converts spoken instructions into high-level locomotion commands, while the manipulation module retargets human hand motions to the robot through inverse kinematics and PD control. The system also records multimodal data, including egocentric RGB observations, voice/text commands, joint states, hand motions, and eye-gaze signals, supporting future imitation learning and autonomy. We evaluate the framework on a Unitree H1 humanoid equipped with dexterous hands in manipulation and social interaction tasks. Results show that novice users can successfully operate the system after brief familiarization, achieving 80\% success in object manipulation and 70\% success in a social cube-passing task. These results demonstrate the potential of immersive, language-assisted teleoperation as an accessible interface for humanoid interaction, remote assistance, and multimodal data collection.

摘要（中文）：摘要：人形机器人可将人类存在延伸至偏远、受限或危险环境，但现有遥操作接口通常需要身体负担沉重的动作追踪或认知负荷较高的底层控制。本文提出一种沉浸式遥操作框架，该框架集成了语音控制移动、基于VR的操控及双向社交交互功能，可实现人形机器人的全身控制。借助Apple Vision Pro，操作者能够获取第一人称视觉反馈，通过自然语言指令控制机器人移动，并利用手腕与手指追踪技术远程操控机器人手臂及灵巧手。LLM辅助的语音控制模块将口语指令转化为高层移动命令，而操控模块则通过逆运动学与PD控制将人类手部动作重映射至机器人。该系统还记录多模态数据，包括第一人称RGB观测、语音/文本指令、关节状态、手部动作及眼动信号，为未来的模仿学习与自主控制提供支持。我们在配备灵巧手的Unitree H1人形机器人上，针对操控与社交交互任务对框架进行了评估。结果表明，新手用户在短暂熟悉后即可成功操作系统，在物体操控任务中达到80%成功率，在社交传递方块任务中达到70%成功率。这些结果证明了沉浸式语言辅助遥操作作为人形交互、远程协助及多模态数据采集的可及性接口的潜力。

Authors: Niraj Pudasaini, Geeta Chandra Raju Bethala, Pranav Doma, Anthony Tzes, Yi Fang

Multi-Agent Robotic Control with Onboard Vision-Language Models VLA

Multi-Agent System Onboard VLM Autonomous Mobile Manipulator Long-horizon Planning Simulated Warehouse

简要说明：本文提出一种多智能体系统架构，利用紧凑型机载视觉语言模型和新颖的编排智能体在模拟仓库中控制移动操作器，展示了替代云依赖部署的可行方案。

TLDR: This paper presents a multi-agent system architecture that uses compact, onboard vision-language models and a novel orchestration agent to control a mobile manipulator in a simulated warehouse, showing a viable alternative to cloud-dependent deployments.

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Language Action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic control. Yet, they face significant challenges regarding explainability, generalization, and compute requirements. This paper presents a Multi-Agent System (MAS) architecture that addresses these limitations by deploying specialized agents on onboard hardware - eliminating dependence on external compute. The system controls a multi-purpose autonomous mobile manipulator in a simulated industrial warehouse, fulfilling five task categories: safety inspection, warehouse maintenance, warehouse search, package quality verification, and responding to human requests. Compact VLMs (3-20B parameters) are used throughout, with fine-tuning applied to improve package inspection accuracy. A novel "Megamind" orchestration agent mitigates context retention issues inherent to long-horizon planning with smaller models. The system was validated in a hardware-in-the-loop simulation using an AMD Ryzen(TM) AI mini PC. Results demonstrate that a fully onboard MAS architecture is a viable, cost-efficient alternative to cloud-dependent deployments, with strong potential for real-world transfer. The simulation environment has been released as open source under the Apache 2.0 licence.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLM）与视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在机器人控制领域展现出应用前景，但仍面临可解释性、泛化能力及计算资源需求等方面的显著挑战。本文提出一种多智能体系统（MAS）架构，通过将专用智能体部署于机载硬件来克服这些局限——从而消除对外部计算的依赖。该系统在模拟工业仓库中控制一台多用途自主移动操作机器人，完成五类任务：安全检查、仓库维护、仓库搜索、包裹质量验证及响应人类请求。研究全程采用紧凑型视觉语言模型（参数规模3B-20B），并通过微调提升包裹检测精度。新型"Megamind"编排智能体可缓解小模型在长时域规划中固有的上下文留存问题。该系统在搭载AMD Ryzen(TM) AI迷你PC的硬件在环仿真中完成验证。结果表明，全机载多智能体系统架构是云依赖型部署方案的可行且低成本替代方案，具有显著的现实场景迁移潜力。仿真环境已基于Apache 2.0许可证开源发布。

Authors: Kajetan Rachwał, Maciej Majek, Bartłomiej Boczek, Jakub Matejczyk, Dominik Matejkowski, Adam Dąbrowski, Tim Seyde, Alexander Amini, Maria Ganzha

HumAIN: Human-Aware Implicit Social Robot Navigation HumanoidEmbodied

social navigation knowledge distillation implicit social cues skeletal keypoints transformer

简要说明：HumAIN 提出了一种知识蒸馏框架，通过 Transformer 教师模型融合隐含社交线索（如骨骼关键点），再蒸馏为轻量级学生模型，实现实时且社会规范的机器人导航。

TLDR: HumAIN proposes a knowledge distillation framework that fuses implicit social cues (e.g., skeletal keypoints) into a transformer-based teacher model, then distills it into a lightweight student for real-time, socially compliant robot navigation.

Abstract: Effective social robot navigation requires sensitivity to human behavior, often revealed through subtle skeletal cues like gait and orientation. We present Human-Aware Implicit Social Robot Navigation (HumAIN), a novel framework that fuses implicit social cues directly into the planning loop via knowledge distillation. We first employ a transformer-based teacher model that fuses rich multi-modal inputs, including historic images, skeletal keypoints, robot state, and a robot's target goal, to learn robust, human-aware representations for the robot's future trajectory planning. To enable real-time deployment, we then distill this knowledge into a lightweight student model. By optimizing for both trajectory reconstruction and latent feature alignment with the teacher, the student learns to infer complex social dynamics from minimal inputs. Bridging the prediction-planning gap with an efficient distilled architecture, our method enables robots to reason about human behavior in a manner that is adaptive, robust, and socially compliant. We validate HumAIN through extensive experiments, where it improves trajectory prediction metrics by an average of 29.8% across all metrics compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These results highlight the benefit of using implicit, whole-body cues to achieve human-like navigation awareness on resource-constrained platforms.

摘要（中文）：有效的社交机器人导航需要感知人类行为，这种感知常通过步态、朝向等细微骨骼线索体现。我们提出人类感知隐式社交机器人导航（HumAIN），该创新框架通过知识蒸馏将隐式社交线索直接融入规划循环。首先，我们采用基于Transformer的教师模型，融合历史图像、骨骼关键点、机器人状态及目标意图等丰富多模态输入，为机器人未来轨迹规划学习鲁棒的人类感知表征。为满足实时部署需求，我们将该知识蒸馏至轻量级学生模型。通过同步优化轨迹重建与教师模型潜在特征对齐，学生模型能够从最小化输入中推断复杂社交动态。该方法采用高效蒸馏架构弥合预测-规划差距，使机器人以自适应、鲁棒且符合社交规范的方式推理人类行为。通过大量实验验证，HumAIN在轨迹预测指标上较现有最优基准全面平均提升29.8%。该结果凸显了利用隐式全身线索在资源受限平台上实现类人导航感知的显著优势。

Authors: Daeun Song, Nhat Le, Jeffrey Chen, Mohammad Nazeri, Amirreza Payandeh, Rohan Chandra, Reuth Mirsky, Ross Mead, Ling Xiao, Xuesu Xiao

Programmable Synchronization Graphs for Adaptive and Fault-Tolerant Modular Miniature Robots Locomotion

modular miniature robots synchronization graph gait programming fault tolerance graph coupling

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于模块化微型机器人的可编程同步图框架，通过图耦合实现无需特权领导者或密集通信的运动协调，在物理机器人集群中展示了步态相位编程、容错性和在线自适应能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces a programmable synchronization-graph framework for modular miniature robots that uses graph coupling to coordinate locomotion without privileged leaders or dense communication, demonstrating gait phase programming, fault tolerance, and online adaptation in physical robot collectives.

Abstract: Modular miniature robots could provide scalable function in constrained environments, but coordinating many imperfect modules remains difficult when computation, communication and reliability are limited. A central robotics challenge is to coordinate many actuator-sensor modules without assigning a privileged leader, prescribing a fixed gait template, or relying on dense communication. Here we introduce a programmable synchronization-graph framework for modular miniature robots in which each actuator-sensor pair is represented as a network node and locomotor coordination is encoded through graph coupling. Fixed intra-subgraph links synchronize heterogeneous actuator groups, whereas a small number of signed inter-subgraph links program phase relationships between groups. In physical robot collectives with up to nine modules, graph coupling drives the emergence of synchronization, signed links tune the phase difference from in-phase to out-of-phase motion, and floor experiments produce gallop-like and trot-like contact patterns in a five-module robot assembly. Replacing dense all-to-all coupling with sparse d-regular topologies preserves synchronization while reducing the coupling burden. The same graph representation also captures fault tolerance: increasing graph degree increases the number of module deactivations tolerated before desynchronization. Finally, an upper-confidence-bound edge-selection algorithm learns inter-subgraph links that drive the system toward target phase states. In a separate deactivation benchmark, the graph-based controller avoids the leader-specific failure mode observed in centralized leader-follower control and reduces worst-case phase error by about threefold. These results establish programmable network topology as a compact control layer for gait phase programming, online adaptation and robustness to unit loss in modular miniature robots.

摘要（中文）：模块化微型机器人能够在受限环境中实现可扩展功能，但当计算能力、通信和可靠性有限时，协调大量存在缺陷的模块仍具挑战性。机器人学中的核心难题在于：如何在无特权领导者、无预设步态模板、无密集通信的条件下，协调大量作动器-传感器模块。本文提出一种适用于模块化微型机器人的可编程同步图框架，其中每个作动器-传感器对表示为网络节点，运动协调通过图耦合编码实现。固定子图内连接用于同步异构作动器群组，而少量带符号的子图间连接则可编程设定群组间的相位关系。在包含多达九个模块的实体机器人集群中，图耦合驱动同步行为的涌现，带符号连接可将相位差从同相运动调谐至反相运动，地面实验在五模块机器人组件中产生了类似奔跑步与对角步态的触地模式。采用稀疏的d-正则拓扑替代密集的全连接拓扑，可在降低耦合负担的同时保持同步性。同一图表示方法还能捕捉容错特性：增加图度数可提升系统在失同步前所能容忍的模块停用数量。此外，基于置信度上界的边选择算法能够学习驱动系统趋向目标相位状态的子图间连接。在独立的停用基准测试中，基于图的控制器避免了集中式主从控制中依赖特定领导者的故障模式，并将最差情况下的相位误差降低约三倍。这些结果确立了可编程网络拓扑作为模块化微型机器人中步态相位编程、在线自适应及抗单元损失鲁棒性的紧凑控制层。

Authors: Okan Kulekcioglu, Arqam Bin Ahmad, Ines Garcia, Filipe Serra Alves, Onur Ozcan, M. Selim Hanay

Ace! Motion Planning of Professional-Level Table Tennis Serves with a Robot Arm Manipulation

motion primitives Model Predictive Control Bayesian Optimization robot arm table tennis serves

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合运动基元、模型预测控制和贝叶斯优化的新方法，使机器人手臂能够生成专业水平的乒乓球发球，转速高达550 rad/s，速度高达6.7 m/s。

TLDR: This paper presents a novel method combining motion primitives, Model Predictive Control, and Bayesian Optimization to generate professional-level table tennis serves with a robot arm, achieving spins up to 550 rad/s and speeds up to 6.7 m/s.

Abstract: Table tennis, a dynamic, compact, and popular sport, has received significant attention as a robotics benchmark over the last decades. Most of the research has focused on the rally aspect - returning an incoming ball - requiring high-speed vision, agile motion planning, and tight closed-loop control. However, the other component of table tennis gameplay - the serve - is comparatively a quite unexplored research problem, that in fact requires pushing physics modeling and control to the extremes. Achieving competitive serves with a robot presents domain-specific challenges, such as high-spin generation from a spinless ball, precise aiming, or multi-objective optimization. In this work, we present a novel approach for generating official rule-compliant serves by combining motion primitives, Model Predictive Control, and Bayesian Optimization. Serves generated in this way offer a wide and controllable variation of spins of up to 550 rad/s, and speeds of up to 6.7 m/s, matching and even surpassing those of elite table tennis players.

摘要（中文）：乒乓球作为一项充满活力、紧凑且广受欢迎的运动，在过去几十年中作为机器人学基准测试受到了广泛关注。大多数研究聚焦于对打环节——回击来球——这需要高速视觉、敏捷运动规划及紧密的闭环控制。然而，乒乓球比赛的另一个组成部分——发球——则相对是一个尚未充分探索的研究问题，实际上它需要将物理建模与控制推向极致。利用机器人实现具有竞争力的发球面临着领域特定的挑战，例如从无旋转球产生高旋转、精确瞄准或多目标优化。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖方法，通过结合运动基元、模型预测控制与贝叶斯优化，生成符合正式规则的发球。以这种方式生成的发球能够实现高达550 rad/s的广泛可控旋转变化，以及最高6.7 m/s的球速，与顶级乒乓球运动员的水平相当甚至超越。

Authors: Guillem Torrente, Guilherme Jorge Maeda, Divij Grover, Megumu Tsukamoto, Hamdi Sahloul, Peter Dürr

SPECTRA: Context-Conditioned Spectral Movement Primitives for Robot Skill Generalization Manipulation

imitation learning frequency-domain movement primitives robot manipulation spectral coefficients

简要说明：本文提出了谱运动基元（SMP），一种用于机器人操作模仿学习的频域框架，在保留任务几何结构的同时，通过相位耦合调节器强制执行关节空间动态约束。

TLDR: This paper introduces Spectral Movement Primitives (SMP), a frequency-domain imitation learning framework for robot manipulation that preserves task geometry while enforcing joint-space dynamic constraints via a phase-coupled regulator.

Abstract: Robot imitation learning for manipulation should preserve demonstrated task geometry while producing dynamically admissible robot motions. Existing pipelines often learn task-dependent trajectories and impose execution limits afterward through filtering, smoothing, clipping, or time scaling, which may distort task-critical end-effector paths. We propose the Spectral Movement Primitive (SMP), a frequency-domain imitation learning framework that couples task-space skill generation with joint-space execution regulation. Demonstrations are represented by truncated finite-horizon Fourier coefficients. An empirically selected low-frequency task band captures the dominant motion geometry, while higher harmonics contribute disproportionately to derivative growth. A frame-aware context-conditioned GMM/GMR prior predicts the task-band coefficients in a canonical task frame, and the resulting Cartesian trajectory is mapped to joint space through sequential inverse kinematics. A phase-coupled regulator then limits the requested phase progression without modifying the spectral coefficients, thereby enforcing joint velocity and acceleration limits while preserving the represented path. Experiments evaluate task-band reconstruction, robustness to composite demonstration corruption, out-of-distribution cross-board generalization, joint-space dynamic admissibility, end-effector path preservation, and deployment on a Franka Panda robot. Results show compact geometric reconstruction, consistent transfer across unseen task frames, substantial reductions in dynamic violations and jerk, and preservation of the intended end-effector path during phase regulation.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作技能的模仿学习应在保留示教任务几何特征的同时，生成动力学可接受的机器人运动。现有流程通常学习任务依赖轨迹，再通过滤波、平滑、截断或时间缩放施加执行限制，这可能导致任务关键末端执行器路径产生畸变。 本文提出频谱运动基元（Spectral Movement Primitive, SMP），这是一种频域模仿学习框架，将任务空间技能生成与关节空间执行调控相耦合。示教数据通过截断的有限时域傅里叶系数表示。经验选取的低频任务频带捕获主导运动几何特征，而高频谐波对导数增长产生不成比例的贡献。基于坐标系感知的上下文条件化高斯混合模型/高斯混合回归（GMM/GMR）先验模型，在规范任务坐标系中预测任务频带系数，生成的笛卡尔轨迹通过序列逆运动学映射至关节空间。随后，相位耦合调节器限制请求的相位进程而不修改频谱系数，从而在保持所表示路径的前提下施加关节速度与加速度限制。 实验评估了任务频带重构能力、对复合示教干扰的鲁棒性、跨分布泛化性能、关节空间动力学可接受性、末端执行器路径保持特性，以及在Franka Panda机器人上的部署效果。结果表明，该方法实现了紧凑的几何重构、跨未见任务坐标系的一致性迁移、动力学违规与加加速度（jerk）的显著降低，并在相位调节过程中保持了预期的末端执行器路径。

Authors: Boxuan Zhang, Sheng Liu, Chenglin Ming, Ahmed Abdelrahman

EvoPlan: Evolutionary Neuro-Symbolic Robot Planning with Spatio-Temporal Guarantees Other

neuro-symbolic planning Signal Temporal Logic evolutionary PDDL planner constraint mining robot policy shielding

简要说明：EvoPlan 是一个神经符号机器人规划框架，结合了基于 LLM 的计划提议与修复、程序化验证以及从演示数据中挖掘的信号时序逻辑（STL）约束，能够为驾驶和导航任务提供可执行且安全的有保证计划。

TLDR: EvoPlan is a neuro-symbolic robot planning framework that combines LLM-driven plan proposal and repair with programmatic validation and Signal Temporal Logic (STL) constraints mined from demonstration data, enabling guaranteed executable and safe plans for driving and navigation tasks.

Abstract: LLM-based robot planners are fluent but cannot guarantee that their plans are executable or safe. Classical PDDL planners can guarantee these properties, but only after the problem is fully specified, and they make poor use of an LLM's ability to read context and repair plans. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework with three parts. All LLM calls use a locally-hosted open-weight model, so the pipeline can be deployed on-robot with no cloud dependency. First, an offline procedure that mines a single global Signal Temporal Logic (STL) constraint on mobility from demonstration data. The procedure recovers codified rules (e.g., stopping at red lights, mined from nuPlan driving logs) or population preferences (e.g., social-navigation comfort, mined from SCAND teleoperation), depending on what the demonstrations encode. Because the demonstrations are a one-class signal, we generate the missing negatives with counterfactual perturbations and an LLM violation generator and then fit the constraint by evolutionary search. We use the mined constraint to shield a vision-language driving policy on Bench2Drive and two discrete-action navigation policies on HA-VLN-CE. Second, an evolutionary PDDL planner: an LLM proposes and repairs plans, programmatic validators decide which ones survive, and the validated portion of the plan grows over iterations. We test the planner on the open-world ALFWorld Text benchmark, where it beats strong baselines and stays robust when the goal vocabulary does not match the action-model vocabulary. Third, a constrained execution loop: the planner's plan is compiled into waypoints, the waypoints are checked against the mined constraint, and the planner re-plans on a violation. We illustrate the full pipeline via demonstrations using the Gazebo simulator.

摘要（中文）：基于大语言模型的机器人规划器虽然生成流畅，但无法保证其规划的可执行性或安全性。经典PDDL规划器能确保这些特性，但必须待问题完全定义后才可运作，且未能充分利用大语言模型理解上下文与修复规划的能力。本文提出一种神经符号框架，包含三个组成部分。所有大语言模型调用均采用本地部署的开放权重模型，因此整个流水线可在机器人端运行，无需依赖云端。首先，通过离线流程从示范数据中挖掘单一全局信号时序逻辑（STL）移动性约束。该流程可恢复编码规则（如从nuPlan驾驶日志挖掘的红灯停车规则）或群体偏好（如从SCAND远程操作数据挖掘的社交导航舒适度），具体取决于示范数据编码的内容。由于示范数据属于单类信号，我们通过反事实扰动和大语言模型违规生成器生成缺失的负样本，再通过进化搜索拟合约束。我们将挖掘的约束用于屏蔽Bench2Drive平台上的视觉语言驾驶策略，以及HA-VLN-CE平台上的两种离散动作导航策略。其次，进化式PDDL规划器：大语言模型提出并修复规划，程序化验证器决定哪些规划得以保留，规划中已验证的部分随迭代次数增长。我们在开放世界ALFWorld Text基准上测试该规划器，其性能超越强基线模型，且在目标词汇与动作模型词汇不匹配时仍保持鲁棒性。第三，受约束的执行循环：规划器生成的规划被编译为航点，航点需通过挖掘的约束检验，若违反约束则规划器重新规划。我们通过Gazebo模拟器的示范演示了完整流水线。
