Authors: Bhavya Sai Nukapotula, Samin Moosavi, Haoze Wang, Luke Duncan, Diya Shakkottai, Varun Murali, Srinivas Shakkottai

Vision Language Action (VLA) Models for Unmanned Aerial Robotics and Bimanual Manipulation: A Review VLA

Vision Language Action models bimanual manipulation unmanned aerial robotics action representations language grounding

简要说明：本综述调查了面向双臂操作和无人航空机器人的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，指出双臂VLA的协调策略可迁移至无人机系统。

TLDR: This review surveys Vision Language Action (VLA) models for bimanual manipulation and unmanned aerial robotics, arguing that coordination strategies from bimanual VLAs transfer to UAV systems.

Abstract: Vision Language Action (VLA) models unify visual perception, natural-language understanding, and action generation within a single foundation model, allowing a robot to follow instructions such as fold the towel or fly to the red building directly from camera images. Because VLAs inherit world knowledge from internet-scale pre-training, they have become the dominant framework for learning-based manipulation, with bimanual coordination serving as the most demanding testbed: two arms with 7 degrees of freedom each must move in concert to fold, assemble, and reorient objects. Unmanned aerial robotics faces a structurally similar challenge: a drone must coordinate thrust, attitude, and increasingly gripper commands from visual observations under strict latency and payload constraints. This review covers 183 contributions spanning 2017-2026 and organized along seven dimensions: VLA architectures, training recipes, action representations, bimanual coordination (2022-2026), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation and control (2017-2026), language grounding, and cross-cutting concerns including memory and world models. We show that the coordination strategies, training recipes, and action representations developed for bimanual VLAs transfer to unmanned aerial systems and identify fourteen research directions across both domains.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉感知、自然语言理解与动作生成统一在单一基础模型中，使机器人能够直接根据摄像头图像执行"叠毛巾"或"飞向红色建筑"等指令。由于VLA继承了互联网规模预训练的世界知识，它们已成为基于学习的操作任务的主流框架，其中双臂协调是最具挑战性的测试平台：每只具有7个自由度的机械臂必须协同动作，完成折叠、组装和调整物体方向等操作。无人航空机器人面临结构相似的挑战：无人机必须在严格的延迟和载荷约束下，根据视觉观测协调推力、姿态及日益增加的夹爪指令。本综述涵盖2017-2026年间183篇文献，沿七个维度展开：VLA架构、训练方案、动作表征、双臂协调（2022-2026）、无人机导航与控制（2017-2026）、语言基础，以及包括记忆与世界模型在内的跨领域问题。研究表明，为双臂VLA开发的协调策略、训练方案和动作表征可迁移至无人航空系统，并识别出两个领域的十四个研究方向。

Authors: Inkyu Sa, Chanoh Park, Hea-Min Lee, Donghee Noh, Ho Seok Ahn

Grounding Spatial Relations in a Compact World Model: Instruction Leakage and a Goal-Free Dynamics Fix VLA

instruction leakage goal-conditioned world model spatial relation grounding reference anchors compact world model

简要说明：本文揭示了目标条件世界模型中的“指令泄露”问题：模型实际转录指令而非感知场景，并通过将目标移出动态模型、监督读取路径来恢复真正的空间关系接地。

TLDR: This paper identifies 'instruction leakage' in goal-conditioned world models for spatial relation grounding, where the model transcribes the instruction rather than perceiving the scene, and proposes a fix by removing the goal from the dynamics and supervising the read path.

Abstract: Compact world models that condition on a language goal promise to ground relations such as ``put the red block left of the blue block'' using a sparse set of explicit \emph{reference anchors}. We ask when such references actually ground a relation, and identify a trap: a goal-conditioned predictor reaches a striking $0.90$ relation-readout accuracy, yet this is \emph{instruction transcription}, not perception. Withholding the goal collapses it to chance ($0.90\!\to\!0.27$, three seeds) and a counterfactual instruction makes the predicted anchors follow the \emph{false} instruction $94.5\%$ of the time (true scene $2.3\%$; $N{=}256$). Tested across three settings and a within-task ablation, our central claim characterizes the confound: \textbf{instruction leakage occurs when the scored quantity is transcribable from the instruction (when the instruction names the answer) and is essentially independent of how predictive the non-instruction inputs are.} Our tabletop and the external BabyAI benchmark leak, whereas a Language-Table forward-dynamics world model whose instruction names \emph{referents} does not, until the instruction is augmented to name the direction; and degrading the action never increases leakage, the opposite of what predictor-competition predicts. The diagnosis prescribes the fix: keep the goal out of the dynamics (it belongs to the planner's cost) and supervise the \emph{read} path, recovering genuine, instruction-independent grounding ($0.88$, identical with and without the goal). The detection protocol and remedy apply to any goal-conditioned world model whose instruction names the scored quantity.

摘要（中文）：以语言目标为条件的紧凑世界模型，旨在通过一组稀疏的显式**参考锚点**来嵌入诸如“将红色方块放在蓝色方块左侧”这类关系。我们探究了此类参考何时真正嵌入关系，并发现一个陷阱：目标条件预测器达到了惊人的0.90关系读取准确率，但这实际上是**指令转录**，而非感知。移除目标后，准确率骤降至随机水平（0.90→0.27，三个种子），而反事实指令则使预测锚点在94.5%的情况下遵循**虚假**指令（真实场景仅占2.3%；N=256）。通过三种实验设置及任务内消融测试，我们的核心主张揭示了这一混淆因素：**当被评分的量可从指令中转录（即指令直接命名答案）且本质上独立于非指令输入的预测能力时，就会发生指令泄漏。** 我们的桌面场景与外部BabyAI基准均存在泄漏，而指令命名**指代对象**的Language-Table前向动态世界模型则未出现泄漏，直到指令被扩充至命名方向为止；此外，降低动作质量从未增加泄漏，这与预测器竞争理论的预测相反。这一诊断指明了修复方法：将目标排除在动态模型之外（目标属于规划器的成本范畴），并对**读取**路径进行监督，从而恢复真正的、与指令无关的嵌入能力（准确率0.88，有无目标时结果一致）。该检测协议与修复方案适用于任何指令命名了被评分量的目标条件世界模型。

Authors: Yufeng Wang, Lu Wei, Haibin Ling

Ego-Human Motion Prediction with 3D-Aware LLM HumanoidEmbodied

egocentric motion prediction 3D scene grounding holistic cross-modal prediction LLM-based motion forecasting GRPO reinforcement finetuning

简要说明：本文提出Ego3DLM，一种3D感知的大语言模型，能从第一人称视频中单次自回归地同时预测过去和未来的人体姿态与叙述，结合3D场景理解与跨模态一致性实现自我中心运动预测。

TLDR: This paper introduces Ego3DLM, a 3D-aware LLM that jointly predicts past/future human poses and narrations from egocentric video in a single autoregressive pass, integrating 3D scene grounding and cross-modal consistency for egocentric motion forecasting.

Abstract: Anticipating human motion from an egocentric perspective is fundamental for proactive assistance in AR/VR, human-robot collaboration, and embodied AI. While recent works incorporate language as a semantic prior to reduce the ill-posed nature of egocentric forecasting, they largely neglect the 3D spatial and semantic context that governs how motion unfolds, and treat pose and language prediction as separate inference streams. We introduce Ego3DLM, built on two core principles: accurate motion forecasting requires explicit spatial and semantic understanding of the 3D environment, and pose and language must be predicted holistically in a single pass, since motion is inherently tied to the semantic interpretation of actions being performed. Given three-point tracking, 3D scene features, and egocentric video, Ego3DLM simultaneously decodes past pose, future pose, past narration, and future narration in a single autoregressive pass, grounding predicted poses and descriptions in one another to enforce cross-modal and temporal consistency. We adopt a three-stage training scheme: (1) spatial-semantic scene awareness pretraining; (2) holistic instruction tuning over all four outputs in a single pass; and (3) GRPO-based reinforcement finetuning with intra- and inter-modal rewards that directly optimize pose-language fidelity. Experiments on the Nymeria benchmark demonstrate that Ego3DLM achieves state-of-the-art performance across future motion prediction, past motion tracking, and motion description, showing that 3D scene grounding and holistic cross-modal prediction yield physically plausible and semantically coherent motion forecasts. The project page is available at https://jaewoo97.github.io/Ego3DLM/.

摘要（中文）：从第一人称视角预测人体运动，对于增强现实/虚拟现实、人机协作以及具身智能中的主动辅助功能至关重要。尽管近期研究将语言作为语义先验以减少自我中心预测的ill-posed问题，但这些工作大多忽略了主导运动展开方式的3D空间与语义上下文，并且将姿态预测和语言预测视为独立的推理流。我们提出Ego3DLM，基于两项核心原则：精确的运动预测需要显式理解3D环境的空间与语义信息；姿态与语言必须通过单次前向传播进行整体预测，因为运动本身与所执行动作的语义解读紧密耦合。给定三点追踪数据、3D场景特征及第一视角视频，Ego3DLM在单次自回归前向传播中同步解码过去姿态、未来姿态、过去叙述和未来叙述，通过相互约束预测的姿态与描述来强制执行跨模态与时间一致性。我们采用三阶段训练方案：(1) 空间-语义场景感知预训练；(2) 对所有四个输出进行单次前向传播的整体指令微调；(3) 基于GRPO的强化微调，利用模态内与模态间奖励直接优化姿态-语言保真度。在Nymeria基准上的实验表明，Ego3DLM在未来运动预测、过去运动追踪及运动描述任务上均达到最先进性能，证明3D场景定位与整体跨模态预测能够生成物理上合理且语义连贯的运动预测。项目页面：https://jaewoo97.github.io/Ego3DLM/。

Authors: Yujin Bae, Jaewoo Jeong, Hyeonseong Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon

Continuous and large-scale: ELEANOR, the soft architected arm inspired by the elephant trunk Manipulation

biomimetic design continuum arm soft robotics tendon-driven actuation whole-body grasping

简要说明：本文提出ELEANOR，一种受象鼻启发的软体仿生连续臂，通过3D打印柔性结构和肌腱驱动实现了整体抓取。

TLDR: This paper presents ELEANOR, a soft, biomimetic continuum arm inspired by the elephant trunk, demonstrating whole-body grasping through 3D-printed compliant structures and tendon-driven actuation.

Abstract: The elephant trunk is a dexterous and versatile manipulator whose performance is still unmatched in robotics. In previous works, modularity was prioritized and relatively small-scale continuum robots were built. We take the natural proboscis of the *Loxodonta africana* species as a model and propose a different design approach which favors structural continuity and dynamic properties that plausibly emulate those of the natural trunk, while conferring high adaptability to the environment and humans. Instead of targeting prescribed behaviors, we show that a biomimetic design based on the macroscopic properties of the natural system enables elephant-like movements and grasping. We build by 3D printing an 85 cm long, compliant, tapered, volumetrically tessellated continuum arm, which is combined with tendon-driven actuation mimicking the longitudinal and oblique muscles of the natural model. We demonstrate whole-body grasping of objects having different shapes and dimensions and discuss a comparison to the biological trunk highlighting aspects of both biology and robotics.

摘要（中文）：象鼻是一种灵巧且多功能的操纵器，其性能在机器人领域至今仍无出其右。以往的研究中，模块化设计被优先考虑，并构建了相对小型的连续体机器人。我们以非洲草原象（*Loxodonta africana*）的自然象鼻为模型，提出了一种不同的设计方法，该方法注重结构连续性和动态特性，能够逼真地模拟自然象鼻的功能，同时赋予其高度的环境适应性和人机交互性。我们并未预设特定行为，而是证明基于自然系统宏观特性的仿生设计能够实现类象的运动与抓取。通过3D打印，我们构建了一个长85厘米、柔顺、锥形且采用体积镶嵌结构的连续体机械臂，并采用模仿自然模型中纵向与斜向肌肉的肌腱驱动方式。我们演示了对不同形状与尺寸物体的整体抓取，并讨论了与生物象鼻的对比，突出了生物学与机器人学两方面的启示。

Authors: Giovanna A. Naselli, Anderson B. Nardin, Seonggun Joe, Ryan Drinkwater, Enrico Donato, Diego Bianchi, Egidio Falotico, Michel C. Milinkovitch, Lucia Beccai

GeoGS-SLAM: Geometry-Only Gaussian Splatting for Dense Monocular SLAM Other

dense visual SLAM 3D Gaussian Splatting geometry-only reconstruction loop closure monocular SLAM

简要说明：本文提出一种仅基于几何的3D高斯泼溅表示用于密集单目SLAM，移除外观参数以加速重建并提高几何精度，同时引入回环检测地图更新策略以防止地图撕裂。

TLDR: This paper proposes a geometry-only 3D Gaussian Splatting representation for dense monocular SLAM, removing appearance parameters to accelerate reconstruction and improve geometric accuracy while introducing a loop closure map update strategy to prevent map tearing.

Abstract: Dense visual SLAM is a fundamental problem in robotics. Recent advances in 3DGS have demonstrated its potential for dense SLAM. Existing 3DGS frameworks focus on both appearance and geometry modeling. However, scene geometry is typically more critical for SLAM than novel view synthesis because downstream robotic tasks, such as navigation and obstacle avoidance, rely primarily on accurate spatial geometry rather than photorealistic rendering. This observation raises a natural question: Is it feasible for 3DGS to perform 3D reconstruction without scene appearance modeling? Motivated by this, we propose Geometry-only Gaussian Splatting (GeoGS), which directly reconstructs scene geometry, and further present GeoGS-SLAM, a dense visual SLAM system built upon this representation. Specifically, GeoGS retains only spatial parameters to reduce the number of per-primitive parameters by over 80%. In contrast to existing 3DGS methods, GeoGS focuses solely on geometric reconstruction, which significantly reduces the number of Gaussian primitives, accelerates geometric convergence, and enhances robustness to illumination variations. In addition, we present an effective training framework that optimizes the Gaussian primitives via single-view and multi-view geometric and photometric supervision, and speeds up geometry convergence with a local-plane driven initialization that better aligns primitives with local structures. Furthermore, we introduce a map update strategy for loop closure that globally transforms the Gaussian map to align it with the corrected pose estimates, thereby preventing map tearing caused by inconsistent per-viewpoint pose corrections in existing methods. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms SOTA methods in terms of online mapping efficiency and geometric reconstruction quality.

摘要（中文）：稠密视觉SLAM是机器人领域的一个基本问题。近期3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术的进展已显示出其在稠密SLAM中的潜力。现有3DGS框架同时关注外观建模与几何建模。然而，对于SLAM而言，场景几何通常比新视角合成更为关键，因为下游机器人任务（如导航与避障）主要依赖精确的空间几何而非逼真渲染。这一观察引出一个自然问题：在不进行场景外观建模的情况下，3DGS是否能够实现三维重建？受此启发，我们提出仅含几何的高斯泼溅（Geometry-only Gaussian Splatting, GeoGS），该方法直接重建场景几何，并进一步构建基于该表示的稠密视觉SLAM系统GeoGS-SLAM。具体而言，GeoGS仅保留空间参数，将每个基元的参数数量减少80%以上。与现有3DGS方法不同，GeoGS专注于几何重建，这显著减少了高斯基元数量、加速了几何收敛，并增强了对光照变化的鲁棒性。此外，我们提出一个有效的训练框架，通过单视图与多视图几何及光度监督优化高斯基元，并采用局部平面驱动的初始化（使基元与局部结构更好对齐）加快几何收敛。进一步，我们引入一种面向闭环的建图更新策略，该策略全局变换高斯地图以对齐校正后的位姿估计，从而避免现有方法中因逐视角位姿校正不一致导致的地图撕裂问题。在合成与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在在线建图效率与几何重建质量方面均优于现有最优方法。

Authors: Lipu Zhou, Yaoyun Kang, Junxiang Pang, Shengkai Sun, Tingting Bao, Kehan Wang

Communicative Efficiency of Single vs. Multi-Axis Robot Neck Motion HumanoidEmbodied

robotic neck morphology communicative efficiency information-theoretic framework multi-axis motion Motor Information Space

简要说明：本文通过信息论框架分析机器人颈部多轴运动对交流效率的影响，发现两个自由度可实现信息传输峰值，而三个自由度会降低清晰度并增加能耗。

TLDR: This paper uses an information-theoretic framework to analyze how multi-axis neck motion in robots affects communicative efficiency, finding that two degrees of freedom achieve peak information transmission while three decrease clarity and increase energy cost.

Abstract: Nonverbal communication through head and neck movement is fundamental to human social signalling, yet how robotic neck morphology translates motion into communicative information remains poorly understood. We present an information-theoretic framework characterising robot neck movement as a communication channel, quantifying information transmitted and energy expended across varied configurations. Using a robotic neck platform, we recorded 84 video stimuli spanning three rotational degrees of freedom (DoF), varying amplitude, acceleration, and frequency, measuring Shannon entropy of pixel-change signals alongside energy consumption. A perceptual study validated communicative interpretations of each motion. While humans typically engage one axis per gesture, robots are unconstrained by biological architecture, motivating tests up to 3 DoF. Yet communicative information peaks at two DoF and decreases at three despite rising energy cost, a phenomenon we term the morphological information bottleneck. Motion parameter effects were parameter-dependent, some additive, others non-linear. We introduce the Motor Information Space, a framework mapping entropy against energy to expose communicative efficiency across morphologies, in which the optimal configuration achieves 5.26 bits at competitive energy cost. Perception data further confirm multi-axis movements reduce clarity. These findings challenge the assumption that anatomical completeness improves robotic expressiveness, establishing a quantitative basis for morphological design in robots, especially humanoids.

摘要（中文）：通过头部和颈部运动实现的非语言交流是人类社会信号传递的基础，然而机器人颈部形态如何将运动转化为交流信息仍鲜为人知。我们提出了一种信息论框架，将机器人颈部运动表征为通信信道，并量化不同构型下的信息传递量与能量消耗。基于机器人颈部平台，我们录制了84个涵盖三个旋转自由度（DoF）的视频刺激，通过改变振幅、加速度和频率，测量了像素变化信号的香农熵及能量消耗。一项感知研究验证了每种运动的交流解释。人类通常每项手势仅涉及单轴运动，而机器人不受生物结构约束，因此可测试多达三个自由度。然而，交流信息量在双自由度时达到峰值，在三自由度时反而下降，尽管此时能量消耗增加——我们将此现象称为“形态信息瓶颈”。运动参数的影响具有参数依赖性，部分呈叠加效应，部分呈非线性。我们提出了“运动信息空间”框架，通过熵与能量的映射揭示不同形态的交流效率，其中最优构型以具有竞争力的能量成本实现了5.26比特的信息量。感知数据进一步证实多轴运动会降低清晰度。这些发现挑战了“解剖完整性可提升机器人表现力”的假设，为机器人（尤其是类人机器人）的形态设计建立了定量基础。

Multimodal Voice Activity Projection for Turn-Taking in Social Robots with Voice-Activity-Related Pretrained Encoders Other

turn-taking prediction multimodal voice activity projection social robots Low-Rank Adaptation self-supervised future-projection

简要说明：提出了一种用于社交机器人轮流对话预测的多模态语音活动投影框架，利用预训练的视听编码器并通过低秩适配进行迁移。

TLDR: Proposes a multimodal (audio-visual) voice activity projection framework for turn-taking prediction in social robots, using pretrained audio-visual encoders adapted via Low-Rank Adaptation.

Abstract: Turn-taking prediction is a key requirement for social robots involved in human-human interaction, particularly in mediator settings, where the robot must anticipate conversational dynamics rather than merely react to pauses. This work presents a Multimodal Voice Activity Projection (MM-VAP) framework that extends the original audio-only VAP formulation to synchronized audio-visual inputs while preserving its self-supervised future-projection objective. The proposed approach builds on pretrained audio-visual backbones originally optimized for speech-related tasks and adapts them through Low-Rank Adaptation to the multimodal turn-taking problem. After independent speaker encoding, an inter-speaker attention stage models the relational dynamics required to project future voice activity. In addition, a semantic consistency loss is introduced to regularize the 256-state output space according to higher-level dialogue activity patterns. Experiments on NoXi and NoXi+J showed improvements over the current baselines, particularly for some turn-taking events. Additional evaluation on the Haru EDR corpus further supported the suitability of this direction for mediation-oriented human-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：话轮转换预测是社交机器人在人-人交互中的一项关键需求，特别是在调解场景下，机器人必须预测对话动态而非仅仅对停顿做出反应。本文提出了一种多模态语音活动投影（MM-VAP）框架，该框架将原始的纯音频VAP方案扩展至同步音视频输入，同时保留了其自监督的未来投影目标。该方法基于预训练的音视频主干网络（最初为语音相关任务优化），并通过低秩适应将其适配至多模态话轮转换问题。在独立说话人编码后，通过说话人间注意力阶段建模投影未来语音活动所需的关系动态。此外，引入语义一致性损失，根据更高层次的对话活动模式对256态输出空间进行正则化。在NoXi和NoXi+J数据集上的实验表明，该方法相较于现有基线有所改进，尤其在某些话轮转换事件上表现更佳。在Haru EDR语料库上的额外评估进一步验证了该方向对于面向调解的人-机器人交互的适用性。

Authors: Antonio Cano, Guillermo Pérez, Luis Merino, Randy Gomez

Safe Reinforcement Learning using Ideas from Model Predictive Control RLRobot

safe reinforcement learning model predictive control safety filter feasible state-action space nonlinear testbed

简要说明：提出一种安全滤波器，将RL动作投影到MPC离线计算的可行集上，在非线性物理平台上实现安全探索。

TLDR: Proposes a safety filter that projects RL actions onto a feasible set computed offline by MPC, enabling safe exploration on a physical nonlinear testbed.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables the synthesis of control policies directly from data, making it highly appealing for complex cyber-physical systems (CPSs) and robotics. A persistent challenge, however, is ensuring strict, hard safety constraints during the active learning phase. In real-world physical systems, violating mechanical limits can cause irreversible damage, necessitating that exploration remains strictly within safe operational regions. We propose a generalized framework that combines the adaptive, high-performance nature of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with the formal safety guarantees of model predictive control (MPC). Using a mathematical model of the system dynamics, offline MPC computations define a feasible state-action space, representing all safe combinations of system states and control inputs that guarantee constraint satisfaction. During training and deployment, the RL agent's instantaneous actions are projected onto this globally verified feasible set via a safety filter. We systematically evaluate our generalized approach on a non-linear 1-DoF laboratory testbed, demonstrating successful exploration and stable policy convergence on physical hardware.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）能够直接从数据中合成控制策略，使其在复杂信息物理系统（CPS）和机器人领域极具吸引力。然而，一个长期存在的挑战是在主动学习阶段确保严格的硬安全约束。在实际物理系统中，违反机械极限可能导致不可逆的损坏，因此探索过程必须严格限制在安全运行区域内。我们提出了一种通用框架，将深度强化学习（DRL）的自适应高性能特性与模型预测控制（MPC）的形式化安全保证相结合。基于系统动力学的数学模型，离线MPC计算定义了可行状态-动作空间，该空间涵盖所有保证约束满足的系统状态与控制输入的安全组合。在训练和部署过程中，RL智能体的即时动作通过安全滤波器投影到这一全局验证的可行集上。我们在非线性单自由度（1-DoF）实验室测试平台上系统评估了该通用方法，证明了在物理硬件上成功实现了探索与稳定策略收敛。

Authors: Georg Schäfer, Jakob Rehrl, Stefan Huber, Simon Hirlaender

Dynamic Object Detection and Tracking in Construction: A Fisheye Camera and LiDAR Sensor Fusion Model Locomotion

LiDAR fisheye camera sensor fusion Kalman filter dynamic object detection

简要说明：一种结合LiDAR和朝上鱼眼相机的传感器融合框架，用于四足机器人在建筑工地上的实时动态物体检测与跟踪，采用圆柱全景投影和卡尔曼滤波。

TLDR: A sensor fusion framework combining LiDAR and upward-facing fisheye camera for real-time dynamic object detection and tracking on a quadruped robot in construction sites, using cylindrical panorama projection and Kalman filtering.

Abstract: Robust dynamic object detection and tracking are essential for enabling robots to operate safely and effectively alongside humans in complex environments such as construction sites. While LiDAR-based SLAM and occupancy grid methods offer viable solutions for detecting and tracking motion, many state-of-the-art 3D vision approaches rely heavily on pre-trained neural networks and require additional post-processing to identify moving objects. Sensor fusion techniques, combining the precision of LiDAR with the semantic richness of RGB imagery, offer a promising alternative. In this work, we present a novel framework that enhances a quadruped robot equipped with a LiDAR sensor and an upward-facing fisheye camera for real-time dynamic object detection and tracking. After identifying moving objects within a registered point cloud, our method assigns semantic labels by projecting 3D coordinates onto a 2D cylindrical panorama, aligning with real-time image-based detections for observation update of the Kalman filter. The proposed system demonstrates high precision, simplicity, and robustness, particularly in handling objects transitioning between dynamic and static states, thus it is well-suited for deployment in real-world construction environments.

摘要（中文）：在复杂环境（如建筑工地）中，鲁棒的动态物体检测与跟踪能力对于机器人安全有效地与人类协同作业至关重要。尽管基于激光雷达的SLAM（同时定位与地图构建）和占据栅格方法为运动检测与跟踪提供了可行的解决方案，但许多前沿的3D视觉方法严重依赖预训练神经网络，且需要额外的后处理步骤来识别移动物体。融合激光雷达精度与RGB图像语义丰富性的传感器融合技术，提供了一种颇具前景的替代方案。本研究提出了一种新颖框架，通过为配备激光雷达传感器和朝上安装的鱼眼摄像头的四足机器人赋予实时动态物体检测与跟踪能力，实现了性能提升。在已配准的点云中识别出移动物体后，本方法通过将3D坐标投影至二维柱面全景图来赋予语义标签，并与基于图像的实时检测结果进行对齐，从而更新卡尔曼滤波器的观测值。所提出的系统展现出高精度、简洁性和鲁棒性，尤其在处理动态与静态状态间切换的物体时表现突出，因此非常适合部署于真实建筑工地环境。

Authors: Yilong Chen, Huili Huang, Yong K. Cho

CaLiSym: Learning Symplectic Dynamics of Real-World Systems through Structured Canonical Lifts Other

symplectic dynamics physics-informed learning canonical lift robotic systems autoregressive prediction

简要说明：CaLiSym 通过将状态嵌入结构化提升的规范相空间，将精确辛学习扩展到具有驱动、耗散和约束的机器人系统，从而为真实世界机器人实现了几何保持的动力学预测。

TLDR: CaLiSym extends exact symplectic learning to robotic systems with actuation, dissipation, and constraints by embedding the state into a structured lifted canonical phase space, enabling geometry-preserving dynamics prediction for real-world robots.

Abstract: Physics-informed learning promises data-efficient and stable dynamics prediction, yet its strongest geometric guarantees have largely remained confined to closed conservative systems. This excludes many robotic systems of practical interest, where actuation, dissipation, and constraints continuously exchange energy and momentum with the environment. We introduce CaLiSym, a lightweight framework that extends exact symplectic learning to such systems by changing where the geometric prior is imposed. Rather than enforcing symplecticity on the measured physical state, CaLiSym embeds the state and its physical ports into a structured lifted canonical phase space, where the learned dynamics evolve through an exactly symplectic map. The lift is explicit and algebraic, requiring neither recurrent latent states, transformer decoders, implicit optimization, nor inference-time ODE integration. We instantiate the framework with generalized-ridge SympNet predictors and introduce GRB-SympNet, a B-spline variant that combines local approximation with exact symplectic structure. Experiments on a controlled dissipative double pendulum, a real-world quadrotor, and a contact-rich quadruped demonstrate consistent improvements in out-of-distribution autoregressive prediction while using parameter-efficient models. At the same time, the learned lifted dynamics preserve the symplectic form to numerical precision. These results show that symplectic learning can be extended beyond conservative mechanics through structured canonical lifts, enabling geometry-preserving dynamics models for real-world robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：基于物理知识的机器学习有望实现数据高效且稳定的动力学预测，但其最强的几何保证在很大程度上仍局限于封闭保守系统。这排除了许多实际应用中具有价值的机器人系统——在这些系统中，驱动、耗散和约束持续与外界交换能量与动量。我们引入CaLiSym，这是一个轻量级框架，它通过改变几何先验的施加位置，将精确辛学习扩展到此类系统。CaLiSym并非在测量得到的物理状态上强制施加辛结构，而是将状态及其物理端口嵌入一个结构化的提升正则相空间，其中学习的动力学通过精确辛映射进行演化。该提升是显式代数的，无需循环隐状态、变换解码器、隐式优化或推理时的常微分方程积分。我们利用广义脊SympNet预测器实例化该框架，并引入GRB-SympNet——一种结合局部逼近与精确辛结构的B样条变体。在可控耗散双摆、真实世界四旋翼飞行器以及高接触四足机器人上的实验表明，该方法在使用参数高效模型的同时，在分布外自回归预测上实现了持续改进。同时，学习到的提升动力学将辛形式保持至数值精度。这些结果表明，通过结构化的正则提升，辛学习可以扩展到保守力学之外，为真实世界的机器人系统提供保持几何特性的动力学模型。

Authors: Aristotelis Papatheodorou, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Natalia Ares, Ioannis Havoutis, Gerard J. Milburn

A Continual Learning Framework for Adaptive Control of Modular Soft Robots Other

continual learning modular soft robots adaptive control closed-loop trajectory tracking tendon-driven soft robot

简要说明：提出一种持续学习框架，使模块化软体机器人控制器能够适应变化的机器人形态而不遗忘已学知识，并在仿真和真实软体机械臂上得到验证。

TLDR: A continual learning framework is proposed to enable modular soft robot controllers to adapt to changing robot morphologies without forgetting previous knowledge, validated on simulated and real soft robotic arms.

Abstract: Soft robots have attracted significant attention in applications such as medical intervention, rehabilitation, and robotic manipulation due to their inherent compliance, flexibility, and high degrees of freedom. Modular soft robots (MSRs), composed of multiple interconnected segments, represent an emerging class of robotic systems with highly deformable and reconfigurable structures capable of performing complex tasks. However, designing controllers for MSRs remains challenging due to their nonlinear dynamics, modeling complexity, and hyper-redundant nature. Existing approaches typically require controllers to be retrained from scratch whenever the robot morphology changes. In this work, we address these challenges through a continual learning inspired control framework capable of incrementally adapting to changes in robot morphology while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Specifically, the proposed framework enables the controller to sequentially learn new MSR configurations without forgetting previously learned ones. In addition, for MSRs with fixed configurations, the same framework can be employed in a distributed manner to learn module-specific dynamics, enabling localized control and improved precision. The proposed approach is validated through closed-loop trajectory tracking experiments in simulation using a tendon-driven soft robot, as well as on a real-world three-module pneumatic soft robotic arm. Furthermore, we demonstrate the adaptive capabilities of the framework through a reaching experiment in which the controller selectively activates only the necessary modules to reach a virtual target position, thereby reducing computational overhead.

摘要（中文）：软体机器人因其固有的柔顺性、灵活性和高自由度，在医疗干预、康复治疗和机器人操作等应用中备受关注。模块化软体机器人由多个相互连接的单元组成，是一类新兴的机器人系统，具有高度可变形和可重构的结构，能够完成复杂任务。然而，由于其非线性动力学特性、建模复杂性及超冗余特性，为模块化软体机器人设计控制器仍面临挑战。现有方法在机器人形态发生变化时通常需要从头重新训练控制器。本研究通过一种受持续学习启发的控制框架来解决这些问题，该框架能够逐步适应机器人形态的变化，同时保留先前获取的知识。具体而言，所提出的框架使控制器能够顺序学习新的模块化软体机器人配置，而不会遗忘先前学过的配置。此外，对于固定配置的模块化软体机器人，该框架可采用分布式方式学习模块特定的动力学特性，从而实现局部控制和更高的精度。通过使用肌腱驱动软体机器人的仿真闭环轨迹跟踪实验，以及实际环境中的三模块气动软体机械臂实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。进一步地，我们通过一个到达实验展示了该框架的自适应能力：控制器仅选择性激活必要模块以到达虚拟目标位置，从而降低计算开销。

Authors: Nilay Kushawaha, Muhammad Sunny Nazeer, Baljinder Singh Bal, Cecilia Laschi, Egidio Falotico

SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research Other

photorealistic simulator Unreal Engine embodied AI programmatic control ground truth modalities

简要说明：SPEAR 是一个 Python 库，通过程序化控制虚幻引擎实现逼真渲染、高速帧捕获和表达性仿真图，支持多智能体控制、城市场景渲染以及与 MuJoCo 的联合仿真等多种具身 AI 应用。

TLDR: SPEAR is a Python library that programmatically controls Unreal Engine to provide photorealistic rendering, high-speed frame capture, and expressive simulation graphs, enabling diverse embodied AI applications such as multi-agent control, city-scale rendering, and co-simulation with MuJoCo.

Abstract: Interactive simulators have become powerful tools for training embodied agents and generating synthetic visual data, but existing photorealistic simulators suffer from limited generality, programmability, and rendering speed. We address these limitations by introducing SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research. At its core, SPEAR is a Python library that can connect to, and programmatically control, any Unreal Engine (UE) application via a modular plugin architecture. SPEAR exposes over 14K unique UE functions to Python, representing an order-of-magnitude increase in programmable functionality over existing UE-based simulators. Additionally, a single SPEAR instance can render 1920x1080 photorealistic beauty images directly into a user's NumPy array at 73 frames per second - an order of magnitude faster than existing UE plugins - while also providing ground truth image modalities that are not available in any existing UE-based simulator (e.g., a non-diffuse intrinsic image decomposition, material IDs, and physically based shading parameters). Finally, SPEAR introduces an expressive high-level programming model that enables users to specify complex graphs of UE work with arbitrary data dependencies among work items, and to execute these graphs deterministically within a single UE frame. We demonstrate the utility of SPEAR through a diverse collection of example applications: controlling multiple embodied agents with distinct action spaces (e.g., humans, cars, and robots) across several in-the-wild UE projects; rendering photorealistic city-scale environments; manipulating UE's procedural content generation systems; rendering synchronized multi-view images of detailed human faces; coordinating an interactive co-simulation with the MuJoCo physics simulator; and editing scenes with natural language via an AI coding assistant.

摘要（中文）：交互式模拟器已成为训练具身智能体与生成合成视觉数据的重要工具，但现有高真实感模拟器在通用性、可编程性及渲染速度方面存在局限。为解决这些问题，我们提出SPEAR：面向高真实感具身人工智能研究的模拟器。SPEAR核心是一个Python库，能够通过模块化插件架构连接并编程控制任意虚幻引擎（UE）应用。该库向Python开放超过1.4万个独特UE函数，相较于现有基于UE的模拟器，可编程功能提升了一个数量级。此外，单个SPEAR实例能以每秒73帧的速率将1920×1080分辨率的高真实感图像直接渲染至用户的NumPy数组——速度较现有UE插件提升一个数量级——同时提供现有任何UE模拟器均不具备的真值图像模态（如非漫反射本征图像分解、材质ID及基于物理的着色参数）。最终，SPEAR引入了一种表达力强的高级编程模型，允许用户定义包含任意数据依赖关系的复杂UE工作图，并在单个UE帧内确定性执行这些图。我们通过多样化的示例应用展示了SPEAR的实用性：在多个野外UE项目中控制具有不同动作空间的多个具身智能体（如人类、汽车和机器人）；渲染高真实感城市级环境；操控UE的程序化内容生成系统；渲染高精度人脸同步多视角图像；协调MuJoCo物理模拟器的交互式协同仿真；以及通过AI编程助手实现自然语言场景编辑。

Authors: Mike Roberts, Renhan Wang, Rushikesh Zawar, Rachith Dey-Prakash, Quentin Leboutet, Stephan R. Richter, Matthias Müller, German Ros, Rui Tang, Stefan Leutenegger, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Vladlen Koltun

Unlocking Temporal Generalization in Hamiltonian Video Dynamics Models WorldModel

Hamiltonian Generative Networks temporal generalization video dynamics prediction world models continuous-time energy function

简要说明：本文分析了哈密顿生成网络在非保守动力学中的失败模式，并提出了修复方法，使其能够以超出训练范围的时变分辨率进行稳定的视频预测。

TLDR: The paper analyzes failure modes in Hamiltonian Generative Networks (HGN) for non-conservative dynamics and proposes fixes to enable stable video prediction at variable temporal resolutions beyond training.

Abstract: World models are typically trained to predict discrete-time physical dynamics with a fixed step size baked into the model weights, preventing prediction at variable temporal resolutions. This matters for hierarchical planning, sim-to-real transfer, and scientific or game-engine applications that must query the same dynamics at multiple timescales. Hamiltonian Generative Networks (HGN) offer a principled path forward, grounding predictions in a continuous-time energy function that is, in principle, independent of the observation frame rate. In practice, however, their temporal generalization breaks down in non-conservative settings. We show that in externally forced, dissipative environments, HGN rollouts at step sizes beyond the training regime fail due to distinct failure modes, including latent magnitude growth driven by an unconstrained action-force map, and global truncation error accumulation from an under-resolved integrator. We identify a targeted fix for each mechanism and demonstrate stable dynamics prediction at temporal resolutions well outside the training distribution. In a detailed analysis, we recommend several strategies for enabling temporal generalization in continuous-time video generation.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 世界模型通常被训练用于预测离散时间的物理动力学，且模型权重中嵌入了固定的步长，这使得其无法以可变的时间分辨率进行预测。这一问题在分层规划、仿真到现实迁移，以及需要在多个时间尺度上查询相同动态特性的科学或游戏引擎应用中尤为关键。哈密顿生成网络（HGN）提供了一条有原理依据的前进路径，其将预测建立在一个连续时间的能量函数上——该函数原则上独立于观测帧率。然而在实际中，它们在非保守场景下的时间泛化能力会失效。我们证明，在外力驱动且存在耗散的环境中，HGN在超出训练范围的步长下进行展开预测时会因不同的失效模式而失败，这些模式包括：由无约束的作用力-映射导致的潜在量级增长，以及由欠分辨率积分器积累的全局截断误差。我们针对每种机制提出了针对性的修正方案，并展示了在远超出训练分布的时间分辨率下仍能实现稳定的动力学预测。通过详细分析，我们推荐了若干策略，以实现连续时间视频生成中的时间泛化能力。
